https://english.nepalnews.com/s/internat.body: The announcement was made during an Informal European Council press conference, where European leaders underlined the importance of a unified European position in negotiations and stressed the need to safeguard Ukraine’s interests and European security. “Today the Leaders agreed that the European Team for negotiations on peace in Ukraine is the EU institutions and the E5 of the Coalition of the Willing – France, Germany, Italy, Poland and the United Kingdom. Our principles and our positions in these negotiations remain well known. And our European team will continue to act in full unity and in close coordination with all Member States,” Costa said in a post on X. European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen also welcomed the renewed diplomatic momentum, emphasising that Europe’s participation would be important in securing a lasting settlement. “I welcome the renewed momentum to move things forward to a just and lasting peace. A strong European presence is important. We have agreed on a European team – E5 plus EU Institutions. We will defend both Ukraine’s and Europe’s interests,” she said. Von der Leyen further said that as multilateral discussions involving the United States, Ukraine and Russia move forward, the European objective would be to end the conflict while ensuring strong security guarantees and a framework for Ukraine’s post-war recovery. “As we move towards multilateral talks with the US, Ukraine and Russia, our goal is clear: End the war and secure a just and lasting peace for Ukraine. This means strong security guarantees and a plan for Ukraine’s post-war prosperity,” she said. She also stressed that continued support for Kyiv and increased pressure on Moscow would be necessary to bring Russia to the negotiating table. “This is why we will soon propose our 22nd sanctions package. And a proposal to close Ukraine’s financing gap for 2027,” von der Leyen added. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk also confirmed the arrangement, describing the negotiations as crucial for the future security of Europe. “Five European countries—France, Italy, Poland, Germany and the United Kingdom (E5)—and European institutions will represent Europe in negotiations with Russia, Ukraine and the USA. At stake are peace in Ukraine and the security of Poland and all of Europe. This is our time,” Tusk said in a post on X. The development comes amid renewed diplomatic engagement between the two sides facilitated by the United States, with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy recently holding discussions with US President Donald Trump’s Special Envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner in Ireland. The meeting followed their discussions with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow and focused on humanitarian issues, greater European participation in peace negotiations and further diplomatic engagements. Zelenskyy said the discussions had produced three key outcomes, including preparations for what could become the largest prisoner exchange since the beginning of the conflict. “First, a humanitarian outcome – prisoners will be released, and we are counting on the largest prisoner exchange since the start of this war,” he said in a post on X. He also stressed the importance of European involvement in the diplomatic process, saying Kyiv wanted European representatives to have an equal position at the negotiating table. “The second outcome – we are involving European representatives even more actively in diplomacy so that they can have an equal seat at the negotiating table. Ukraine always defends the interests of all of Europe,” Zelenskyy said. The Ireland meeting followed talks between Witkoff, Kushner and Putin at the Kremlin in Moscow. The discussions came after two days of trilateral negotiations involving Russia, Ukraine and the United States in Abu Dhabi, which concluded without a breakthrough but reportedly made progress on several issues, including preparations for a prisoner exchange. However, significant differences remain over territorial arrangements and future security guarantees. During the Kremlin discussions, Putin reiterated Moscow’s opposition to the deployment of foreign troops on Ukrainian territory following a potential peace agreement. “The presence of any foreign troops on Ukrainian territory is absolutely unacceptable to us,” Putin said. The inclusion of the E5 countries and EU institutions in Europe’s negotiating team marks a coordinated effort by European leaders to ensure the continent has a unified voice in ongoing diplomatic efforts to end the Ukraine conflict. https://english.nepalnews.com/s/internat.body_zh: 这项消息是在欧洲理事会非正式会议后的新闻发布会上宣布的。会上，欧洲领导人强调，在谈判中形成统一欧洲立场的重要性，并强调必须维护乌克兰的利益和欧洲安全。Costa在X平台发文称：“今天，领导人一致同意，负责乌克兰和平谈判的欧洲团队将由欧盟机构和愿意联盟的E5国家组成——法国、德国、意大利、波兰和英国。我们的原则以及我们在这些谈判中的立场一直都是明确的。我们的欧洲团队将继续保持完全团结，并与所有成员国密切协调。”欧盟委员会主席Ursula von der Leyen也对重新启动的外交势头表示欢迎，强调欧洲的参与对于达成持久解决方案至关重要。她说：“我欢迎重新出现的势头，推动局势朝公正、持久和平迈进。欧洲的强大参与十分重要。我们已经商定组建欧洲团队——E5加欧盟机构。我们将同时维护乌克兰和欧洲的利益。”von der Leyen进一步表示，随着涉及美国、乌克兰和俄罗斯的多边讨论取得进展，欧洲的目标将是结束冲突，同时确保提供有力的安全保证，并建立乌克兰战后恢复框架。她说：“随着我们与美国、乌克兰和俄罗斯走向多边会谈，我们的目标很明确：结束战争，为乌克兰争取公正、持久的和平。这意味着提供有力的安全保证，并制定乌克兰战后繁荣计划。”她还强调，必须继续支持基辅并加大对莫斯科的压力，才能促使俄罗斯坐到谈判桌前。von der Leyen补充道：“正因如此，我们将很快提出第22轮制裁方案，并提出一项弥补乌克兰2027年融资缺口的计划。”波兰总理Donald Tusk也确认了这一安排，称这些谈判对欧洲未来安全至关重要。Tusk在X平台发文说：“五个欧洲国家——法国、意大利、波兰、德国和英国（E5）——以及欧洲机构将代表欧洲，与俄罗斯、乌克兰和美国进行谈判。关乎乌克兰的和平以及波兰和整个欧洲的安全。这是我们的时刻。”这一进展出现在美国推动双方重新展开外交接触之际。乌克兰总统Volodymyr Zelenskyy最近在爱尔兰与美国总统Donald特朗普的特使Steve Witkoff和Jared Kushner举行了会谈。此次会面是在他们于莫斯科与俄罗斯总统Vladimir Putin会晤之后进行的，重点讨论人道主义问题、欧洲更广泛参与和平谈判以及进一步的外交接触。Zelenskyy表示，此次讨论取得了三项关键成果，其中包括为可能成为冲突开始以来规模最大的一次战俘交换做准备。他说：“第一项成果是人道主义成果——战俘将获释，我们正在争取实现这场战争开始以来规模最大的一次战俘交换。”他还强调欧洲参与外交进程的重要性，称基辅希望欧洲代表在谈判桌上拥有平等席位。Zelenskyy说：“第二项成果是，我们将让欧洲代表更积极地参与外交事务，使他们能够在谈判桌上拥有平等席位。乌克兰始终维护整个欧洲的利益。”爱尔兰会议是在Witkoff、Kushner和Putin于莫斯科克里姆林宫会谈之后举行的。此前，俄罗斯、乌克兰和美国在阿布扎比举行了两天的三方谈判。谈判虽未取得突破，但据报道在多个问题上取得了进展，包括为战俘交换作准备。不过，双方在领土安排和未来安全保证问题上仍存在重大分歧。普京在克里姆林宫讨论时重申，莫斯科反对在可能达成和平协议后向乌克兰领土部署外国军队。普京说：“任何外国军队出现在乌克兰领土上，都是我们绝对无法接受的。”将E5国家和欧盟机构纳入欧洲谈判团队，表明欧洲领导人正采取协调行动，确保欧洲在结束乌克兰冲突的持续外交努力中发出统一声音。（ANI）

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/f.summary_zh: 尼日利亚出口促进委员会（NEPC）执行董事兼首席执行官Nonye Ayeni女士在河套州霍尔港举行的国家单一窗口第二阶段出口宣传暨利益相关方论坛上说，该举措对于维持尼日利亚不断增长的非石油出口表现至关重要。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/f.body: Speaking at the National Single Window Phase 2 Export Sensitisation and Joint Stakeholders’ Forum in Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Executive Director/Chief Executive Officer of the Nigerian Export Promotion Council (NEPC), Mrs. Nonye Ayeni, said the initiative was critical to sustaining the country’s growing non-oil export performance. Represented by Mr. Ndubueze Okeke, Director, Trade Information, the NEPC chief executive disclosed that Nigeria generated $6.1 billion in non-oil export earnings in 2025, representing an 11.5 per cent increase from the $5.46 billion recorded in 2024. While describing the performance as encouraging, the NEPC boss stressed that increased production alone would not guarantee Nigeria’s emergence as a leading non-oil exporting nation without efficient trade facilitation systems. “Nigeria’s ambition to become a leading non-oil exporting nation cannot be achieved by production alone. It also requires efficient systems that enable our businesses to move their products from local markets to international destinations with minimal delays, reduced costs and predictable regulatory processes,” the executive director said. She explained that the National Single Window, a federal government initiative, would provide a unified digital platform for submitting and processing trade-related documents, permits and approvals, thereby improving inter-agency coordination, eliminating duplication and reducing administrative burdens on businesses. The NEPC boss disclosed that the council had commenced its engagement and onboarding process to integrate relevant export-related services into the platform, including its Exporter’s Certificate registration service. She emphasised the need for exporters to understand the relationship between the NSW platform, the Trade Monitoring System (TRMS), Forms NXP and NCX, as well as applicable registration, permit and certification requirements. “Our objective is to ensure a seamless transition that simplifies processes rather than creates additional burdens for businesses,” she stated. The executive director said the Phase 2 implementation was particularly significant to the South-South region, given its vast opportunities in agriculture, fisheries, aquaculture, agro-processing and manufacturing. She urged exporters and business operators to participate actively in the technical sessions covering exporter’s certificate registration, NSW trader registration, TRMS and the processing of Forms NXP and NCX. According to her, the success of the initiative would depend not only on technology but also on effective collaboration among government agencies and the willingness of private-sector operators to embrace the new processes. Meanwhile, the Director of the National Single Window, Mr. Tola Fakolade, said the first component of Phase 2 would go live on December 14, beginning with the digital issuance of export permits by regulatory agencies, including the Standards Organisation of Nigeria (SON), the National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC), and the Federal Produce Inspection Service. He added that the second component, covering Central Bank of Nigeria processes, would be deployed in the first quarter of 2027. Fakolade said the platform would strengthen regulatory compliance and curb revenue leakages, noting that the first phase had simplified import documentation by allowing traders to submit licences and permits through a single platform. “Because of the enforced compliance on the platform, it actually forces users to be compliant. And when there is compliance, then there is blockage of revenue leakages,” he said. Also speaking, Comptroller Aondona Fanyam, in charge of Compliance and Modernisation at the Nigeria Customs Service Headquarters, said the initiative would eliminate repeated submission of documents to multiple government agencies. He explained that traders would submit their documents once, while relevant agencies would access the required information electronically through the platform. Fanyam identified capacity gaps, change management and differences in the digital capabilities of regulatory agencies as some of the challenges encountered during Phase 1, adding that stakeholder sensitisation and practical training were being intensified ahead of the next phase. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/f.title_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府采取行动消除出口瓶颈
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/f.body_zh: 在河流州哈科特港举行的国家单一窗口第二阶段出口宣传暨利益相关方联合论坛上，尼日利亚出口促进委员会（NEPC）执行董事兼首席执行官诺妮耶·阿耶尼表示，这一举措对于保持尼日利亚不断增长的非石油出口表现至关重要。NEPC首席执行官在贸易信息总监Ndubueze Okeke先生代表出席的情况下透露，尼日利亚2025年获得61亿美元非石油出口收入，较2024年的54.6亿美元增长11.5%。NEPC负责人在形容这一表现令人鼓舞的同时强调，如果没有高效的贸易便利化体系，仅靠增加产量无法确保尼日利亚成为领先的非石油出口国。“尼日利亚成为领先非石油出口国的目标不能仅靠生产来实现。它还需要高效的体系，使我们的企业能够将产品从本地市场运往国际市场，同时将延误降至最低、成本降下来，并确保监管流程可预测，”这位执行董事说。她 explained that 国家单一窗口是联邦政府的一项举措，将提供一个统一的数字平台，用于提交和处理贸易相关文件、许可证和审批，从而改善机构间协调，消除重复工作，并减轻企业的行政负担。NEPC负责人透露，该委员会已启动与相关方的接洽及平台接入流程，将出口相关服务整合到该平台，其中包括出口商证书注册服务。她强调，出口商需要了解NSW平台、贸易监测系统（TRMS）、NXP表格和NCX表格之间的关系，以及适用的注册、许可和认证要求。“我们的目标是确保实现平稳过渡，简化流程，而不是给企业增加额外负担，”她表示。执行董事表示，鉴于该地区在农业、渔业、水产养殖、农产品加工和制造业方面拥有巨大机遇，第二阶段的实施对南部地区尤其意义重大。她敦促出口商和经营者积极参加有关出口商证书注册、NSW贸易商注册、TRMS以及NXP表格和NCX表格处理的技术会议。她说，该举措能否成功不仅取决于技术，也取决于政府机构之间的有效协作，以及私营部门经营者接受新流程的意愿。与此同时，国家单一窗口主任Tola Fakolade先生表示，第二阶段的第一部分将于12月14日上线，首先由各监管机构以数字方式签发出口许可证，包括尼日利亚标准组织（SON）、国家食品药品监督管理总局（NAFDAC）和联邦农产品检验局。他补充说，涵盖尼日利亚中央银行相关流程的第二部分将于2027年第一季度部署。Fakolade表示，该平台将加强监管合规并减少收入流失，并指出第一阶段已通过允许贸易商通过一个平台提交许可证和批准文件，简化了进口文件要求。“由于平台实行强制合规，它实际上会迫使用户遵守规定。而一旦实现合规，就能堵住收入流失的漏洞，”他说。尼日利亚海关总署合规与现代化负责人Aondona Fanyam总审计长也表示，该举措将消除向多个政府机构反复提交文件的问题。他解释说，贸易商只需提交一次文件，相关机构便可通过平台以电子方式获取所需信息。Fanyam指出，各监管机构在能力建设、变革管理以及数字化能力方面的差异，是第一阶段实施过程中遇到的部分挑战；下一阶段启动前，各方正加强利益相关方宣传和实务培训。THISDAY创刊于1995年1月22日，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕克里克路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区及世界各地设有办公室。对于政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶级而言，THISDAY是尼日利亚最具权威性的全平台新闻媒体，同时为有抱负者和千禧一代提供新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。该报秉持公众信任，专注于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、市场、艺术、体育、社区以及人与社会的交汇点等各类议题。您可以发送电子邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/techno.summary_zh: 订阅即可解锁全文。微软多项服务在全球范围内出现中断，故障始于2026年11月12日星期四，并持续至2026年11月13日星期五深夜，影响了印度多家企业的内部沟通和面向客户的运营。该公司在2026年11月13日星期五发布的最新消息中表示，正在努力修复此次服务中断；此次中断影响了全球企业、公共服务部门和其他组织的电子邮件访问及办公应用。
https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/techno.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription The global disruption of multiple Microsoft services, which began on Thursday (November 12, 2026) and continued late into Friday (November 13, 2026), affected several Indian businesses’ internal communications and customer-facing operations. In its latest update on Friday (November 13, 2026), the company said it was making progress in fixing the outage, which has affected email access and workplace applications in businesses, public services, and other organisations across the globe. In India, the disruptions affected businesses from startups to multinational corporations. A senior executive at a major telecom company in India told The Hindu that employees were unable to access emails or send service-disruption alerts to customers. Call-centre traffic also increased, the executive said. Rahul Ganapathy, co-founder and CEO of deep tech startup Atsuya Technologies, said customer emails and scheduled Teams meetings were disrupted, although his company did not rely entirely on Microsoft internally. At a Big Four professional services firm in Bengaluru, a senior employee said its internal operations were affected, but added that IT teams were restoring services. The disruptions also left airlines experiencing customer-support delays. IndiGo said its email support was affected and advised customers to use 6E Skai, its AI-powered virtual assistant. Akasa Air warned of email support delays and directed passengers to its customer care centre and social media. Air India said flight operations were unaffected, although it rerouted emails. Separately, India’s Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In), under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, issued a high-severity advisory on Friday, warning of multiple vulnerabilities in Microsoft products. It flagged an Outlook vulnerability that it said was being actively exploited and urged users to apply security updates. The advisory did not explicitly link the vulnerabilities to the outage. Microsoft identified Exchange Online — described as its cloud-based messaging platform that delivers email, calendar, contacts, and tasks — as the primary service affected. Some Microsoft Graph requests accessing Exchange Online data timed out, affecting dependent features in Teams, Copilot, and SharePoint, the company said. Core Teams messaging and online meetings largely continued normally, it added. On Friday, Microsoft said recovery was progressing, with improvements in North America and Europe and encouraging signs in Asia-Pacific. Service availability and email delivery were improving, but intermittent access problems and delays could continue, it said, adding that it was working through email backlogs and retained a 48-hour timeout window to protect delayed messages. Service health and capacity had not fully returned to baseline, it said. Around 8 p.m. IST on Friday (November 13, 2026), Charles Lamanna, executive vice president of Copilot, Agents and Platform at Microsoft, said, "We’re seeing encouraging recovery progress, with service availability and email delivery performance improving across a growing portion of affected infrastructure. We know our customers rely on our services to get important work done every day, and regret the impact these outages had on those who depend on us. Our teams are reviewing what happened and how we can prevent similar issues going forward." The company said it was not aware of any malicious activity causing the disruption and promised that it would publish a detailed report on the root cause and corrective measures after services were restored. In some countries, government services were affected by the outage. Singapore’s Government Technology Agency and Japanese Ministries reported email disruptions, according to local media reports and official notices. In Britain, Rachel Harrison of the GMB Union said National Health Service staff handling emergency calls could not refer to patient details as they normally would, creating a “massive backlog”. Britain’s National Pharmacy Association said the outage delayed prescriptions, AFP reported. Sai Rahul Poruri, CEO of FOSS United, said India should reduce dependence on external technology providers. He called for a more diverse provider ecosystem, citing Germany’s approach of allowing individual regions to choose their email providers, many of which use free and open-source software. Sambratha Shetty, chief operating officer of Synergia Foundation, said disruption could delay client deliveries and expose IT firms and global capability centres in Bengaluru to service-level agreement penalties. She called for backup channels, multiple providers, and tested continuity plans. Ben Mudie, field chief technology officer for APAC at cybersecurity firm Tenable, warned that employees could turn to personal email accounts and unauthorised file-sharing services when workplace systems become unavailable, potentially exposing sensitive company information. technology (general) / economy, business and finance / India Comments have to be in English, and in full sentences. 确认为受此次中断影响的主要服务；该服务是 Microsoft 基于云的通信平台，提供电子邮件、日历、联系人和任务功能。公司表示，一些访问 Exchange Online 数据的 Microsoft Graph 请求出现超时，影响了 Teams、Copilot 和 SharePoint 的相关功能。Microsoft 补充称，Teams 的核心消息通信和在线会议总体上仍能正常运行。Microsoft 在星期五表示，恢复工作正在推进，北美洲和欧洲的服务已有改善，亚太地区也出现积极迹象。公司表示，服务可用性和电子邮件投递情况正在改善，但间歇性访问问题和延迟可能仍会持续；公司正在处理积压的电子邮件，并保留48小时的超时窗口，以保护延迟发送的消息。服务健康状况和容量尚未完全恢复至中断前的基准水平。2026年11月13日星期五印度标准时间晚上8点左右，Microsoft Copilot、Agents and Platform 执行副总裁 Charles Lamanna 表示：“我们看到恢复工作取得积极进展，受影响基础设施中越来越大的部分已实现服务可用性和电子邮件投递性能改善。我们知道客户每天依赖我们的服务完成重要工作，对这些中断给依赖我们服务的人造成的影响深表遗憾。团队正在审查事件经过，并研究如何防止今后再次出现类似问题。”公司表示，未发现此次中断由任何恶意活动引起，并承诺在服务恢复后公布一份关于根本原因和纠正措施的详细报告。在一些国家，中断影响了政府服务。据当地媒体报道和官方通知，新加坡政府科技局及日本各部委报告了电子邮件中断。在英国，GMB Union 的 Rachel Harrison 表示，国民医疗服务体系工作人员无法像平时那样查询患者详情处理紧急呼叫，造成“大量积压”。据法新社报道，英国 National Pharmacy Association 表示，中断导致处方延迟。FOSS United 首席执行官 Sai Rahul Poruri 表示，印度应减少对外部技术供应商的依赖。他呼吁建立更多元化的供应商生态，并援引德国的做法：允许各个地区自行选择电子邮件供应商，其中许多供应商使用免费开源软件。Synergia Foundation 首席运营官 Sambratha Shetty 表示，中断可能延迟客户交付，并使班加罗尔的 IT 企业和全球能力中心面临服务级别协议罚款。她呼吁设置备用渠道、采用多个供应商，并定期测试业务连续性计划。网络安全公司 Tenable 亚太区现场首席技术官 Ben Mudie 警告称，工作场所系统不可用时，员工可能转而使用个人电子邮件账户和未经授权的文件共享服务，从而可能泄露公司敏感信息。科技（综合）/经济、商业与金融/印度 https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/e.title: EFCC Only Recovered Pipeline Transportation Fees, Nembe Clarifies
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/e.summary: The oil company, formerly known as Aiteo Eastern Exploration and Production Company Limited, explained that contrary to media reports the recovered funds relate to outstanding pipeline transportation fees from the use of a Joint Venture (JV) pipeline.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/e.summary_zh: 这家石油公司原名Aiteo Eastern Exploration and Production Company Limited，该公司解释称，与媒体报道相反，追回的款项与使用合资企业（JV）管道产生的未付管道运输费有关。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/e.body: The Nembe Exploration and Production Company Limited (Nembe), has clarified that recent recoveries by the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC), has nothing to do with the funds recovered from oil companies in respect of outstanding obligations relating to the Nembe Creek Trunkline. The oil company, formerly known as Aiteo Eastern Exploration and Production Company Limited, explained that contrary to media reports the recovered funds relate to outstanding pipeline transportation fees from the use of a Joint Venture (JV) pipeline. Nembe management in a statement yesterday lamented that the media reports, which referred to Aiteo alongside Newcross Exploration and Production Limited, have created two misleading impressions of Nembe’s role in the recoveries, particularly regarding outstanding pipeline transportation fees. According to Nembe’s management, the company’s name was changed to Nembe Exploration and Production Company Limited in the second quarter of 2025. “The position is straightforward, Nembe, as operator of the Nembe Creek Trunkiine (NCTL) on behall of its Joint Venture (NV) with the Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPCL), provided crude oil transportation services to third party operators, including Newcross. Over time, outstanding transportation fees arose from the use of the pipeline, which Nembe was responsible for pursuing on behalf of the JV,” the statement read in part. The management recalled that the matter dated back several years, to when the Nigerian oil and gas industry was grappling with widespread crude oil theft, pipeline vandalism, insecurity and other operational disruptions, particularly since the COVID-19 period. According to Nembe, the problems which affected crude transportation through the NCTL made the reconciliation of volumes delivered by individual operators increasingly difficult. “Before the EFCC’s involvement, Nembe made repeated efforts to recover the outstanding payments through direct demands, correspondence and engagements with the pipe line users. “These efforts did not secure full settlement of the indebtedness. The EFCC subsequent intervention brought its statutory investigative and recovery powers to bear on the outstanding obligations, facilitating the recovery of funds that Nembe had already sought to recover on behalf of the JV. “The EFCC’s intervention in respect of these transportation fees was therefore aimed at recovering money owed to the JV, not money from Nembe. Nembe was the operator responsible for pursuing the outstanding payments on behalf of the JV, not the defaulting party in the underlying transactions,” the statement added. Nembe therefore urged that the recovery of these fees should be understood as the settlement of outstanding payment obligations for services rendered, rather than evidence of wrongdoing or financial misconduct by the company. The oil firm stated that changes in the leadership of the anti-graft agency may have contributed to a misunderstanding of the circumstances surrounding the matter and the respective roles of the parties involved. The management stressed that Nembe is not indebted to the JV in respect of the pipeline transportation fees in question, adding that the separate issue concerning stamp duty arising from the acquisition of OML 29 and the NCTL remains the subject of an ongoing reconciliation process with the relevant statutory authorities. “Nembe continues to engage in that process, during which the applicable obligations and amounts are being examined. This matter is entirely distinct from the recovery of outstanding pipeline transportation fees and should be treated accordingly. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/e.title_zh: 经济和金融犯罪委员会仅追回了管道运输费，Nembe对此作出澄清
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/e.body_zh: Nembe Exploration and Production Company Limited（Nembe）澄清，经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）近期追回的款项，与从石油公司追回的、涉及Nembe Creek Trunkline未结义务的资金无关。这家石油公司原名Aiteo Eastern Exploration and Production Company Limited。公司解释称，与媒体报道相反，追回的款项来自使用合资企业（JV）管道所产生的未付管道运输费。Nembe管理层在昨日发表的声明中表示，将Aiteo与Newcross Exploration and Production Limited一并列入的媒体报道，对Nembe在追回款项中的角色造成了两种误导性印象，尤其是在未付管道运输费方面。Nembe管理层表示，公司名称于2025年第二季度变更为Nembe Exploration and Production Company Limited。声明部分内容称：“情况很简单。Nembe代表其与尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPCL）的合资企业（NV）运营Nembe Creek Trunkiine（NCTL），为包括Newcross在内的第三方运营商提供原油运输服务。随着时间推移，管道使用产生了未付运输费，而Nembe负责代表合资企业追收这些费用。”管理层回顾称，此事可追溯至数年前。当时，尼日利亚石油和天然气行业正面临大范围原油盗窃、管道破坏、安全局势恶化及其他运营中断，尤其是自新冠疫情时期以来。Nembe表示，影响通过NCTL运输原油的种种问题，使核实各运营商所交付的数量变得日益困难。声明称：“在EFCC介入之前，Nembe曾通过直接催缴、信函往来以及与管道用户接洽，多次努力追收未付款项。“这些努力未能确保债务得到全额清偿。随后，EFCC运用其法定调查和追缴权力处理未结义务，协助追回了Nembe此前已代表合资企业 sought to recover 的资金。“因此，EFCC就这些运输费采取行动的 aims 旨在追回欠合资企业的款项，而不是从Nembe追回资金。Nembe是负责代表合资企业追收未付款项的运营商，并非相关交易中的违约方。”Nembe因此 urged，应将这些费用的追回理解为对已提供服务所产生未付款项的清偿，而不是公司存在不当行为或财务失当的证据。这家石油公司表示，反贪机构领导层的变动可能促成了外界对该事件背景及相关各方角色的误解。管理层强调，就相关管道运输费而言，Nembe并不欠合资企业任何款项；此外，因收购OML 29和NCTL而产生的印花税这一独立问题，仍在与相关法定机构进行持续核对。声明称：“Nembe继续参与这一核对过程，目前正在审查适用的义务及金额。此事与追回未付管道运输费完全无关，应予区别对待。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创刊，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕Creek Road 35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区以及世界各地设有办公室。作为尼日利亚最权威、覆盖所有平台的新闻媒体，THISDAY服务于政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶层，同时为有抱负者和千禧一代提供新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。这份报纸是一项公共信托，致力于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育、社区以及人与社会的交汇点。您可以发送电子邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

Unlock these with Subscription The fifth round of the India-Bangladesh consular dialogue will be held on a “mutually convenient date”, the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said on Friday (November 13). Speaking to the media during the bi-weekly media briefing, Randhir Jaiswal, Official Spokesperson of the MEA, reiterated that India seeks to build “positive, constructive and forward-looking” relations with Bangladesh. “The next round of the India-Bangladesh Consular Dialogue, which will also take up matters relating to the Revised Travel Arrangement, will be held on a mutually convenient date. India remains ready to discuss all bilateral issues with Bangladesh through these existing mechanisms, including at the technical level,” Mr. Jaiswal said. The Hindu had reported on Thursday (November 12) about the postponement of the consular talks that were to be held on November 17 and 18. “India desires a positive, constructive, and forward-looking relationship with Bangladesh. Accordingly, initiatives have been taken and meetings held under our structured mechanisms in such areas as trade, railways, water resources, and border management, among others,” said Mr. Jaiswal. Diplomatic sources had indicated that the postponement was because of the spike in tensions in view of the proposed return of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to Bangladesh. Ms. Hasina has been in India since August 5, 2024 and she has said that she would return to Dhaka in December. The two sides started consular dialogue in 2017 to strengthen people-to-people contact by having a regular channel of communication on consular, visa, and mutual legal assistance cooperation matters. Four rounds of consular dialogue were held during the rule of the Awami League in Dhaka. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/i.body_zh: 订阅可解锁《The Hindu》会员内容，包括深度报道、社论、观点文章等。印度外交部（MEA）周五（11月13日）表示，印度与孟加拉国领事对话第五轮将在“双方商定的日期”举行。外交部发言人_randhir Jaiswal在双周媒体简报会上对记者表示，印度寻求与孟加拉国建立“积极、建设性和面向未来”的关系。Jaiswal先生表示：“下一轮印度—孟加拉国领事对话还将讨论修订后的旅行安排等事项，将于双方商定的日期举行。印度仍准备通过现有机制，包括技术层面，就所有双边问题与孟加拉国进行讨论。”《The Hindu》此前于周四（11月12日）报道，原定于11月17日和18日举行的领事会谈已推迟。Jaiswal先生表示：“印度希望与孟加拉国建立积极、建设性和面向未来的关系。为此，我们已在贸易、铁路、水资源、边境管理等领域，通过双方建立的机制采取了相关举措并举行了会议。”外交消息人士曾指出，推迟的原因是鉴于前总理谢赫·哈西纳拟返回孟加拉国，紧张局势有所升温。哈西纳女士自2024年8月5日起一直在印度，并表示将于12月返回达卡。两国于2017年启动领事对话，通过就领事、签证和司法协助合作等事项建立定期沟通渠道，加强两国人民之间的联系。阿瓦米联盟执政达卡期间，双方共举行了四轮领事对话。外交部表示，2024年5月举行的第四轮对话讨论了“签证事项、遣返、司法协助条约案件等”问题。评论必须使用英文，并以完整句子表述。评论不得含有辱骂性内容或针对个人。请遵守我们的社区评论准则。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已是《The Hindu》注册用户并已登录，可以继续参与文章互动。如果你没有账户，请注册并登录后发表评论。用户登录自己的账户后，可以在Vuukle上查看以前的评论。

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary_zh: 德里高等法院已下令由专家复核2026年6月UGC-Net考试选拔考生所用答案标准中的四道题答案，并指出答案标准中的错误可能影响考生的成绩排名和参评资格。Jasmeet Singh法官组成的合议庭在11月5日作出、并于星期四公布的裁决中，指示专家委员会在三周内对此事作出裁定，称答案标准似乎存在错误。
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: The Delhi high court has ordered an expert review of four answers in the answer key for the examination to select candidates for UGC -Net June 2026, observing that errors in the answer key can impact a candidate’s merit ranking and eligibility. The examination, UGC-NET was conducted between June 22 to June 30, and approximately 7,27,506 candidates appeared for it, the results of which were declared in August, this year. A bench of justice Jasmeet Singh in his November 5 verdict, released on Thursday directed the expert committee to decide on the matter in three weeks, saying that the answer key appeared to contain errors. Also Read | Planning to take NET? NTA explains how UGC-NET differs from CSIR-UGC NET– check eligibility, exam pattern “An error of this kind should not be suffered by the candidates. A wrong key in a competitive examination affects ranking and eligibility, since the marks awarded on the basis of the key determine a candidate’s merit position and whether the candidate crosses the qualifying cut-off, and even a single mark may decide whether a candidate is considered,” the court said. The court passed the order while hearing five petitions filed by candidates who appeared for UGC-NET examination, challenging discrepancies in 10 answers from the provisional and final answer keys. The UGC-NET June 2026 examination was marred by several controversies, with candidates raising concerns over errors in question papers, alleged repetition of questions and discrepancies in answer keys. The English paper particularly attracted criticism after 67 of its 150 questions were reportedly repeated from the 2024 examination. Complaints regarding the English, Commerce and Sociology papers prompted the NTA to conduct a fresh examination in September 2026. Also Read | NTA to recruit Group A and B posts, apply for Director and other posts at nta.ac.in In its order, of the 10 disputed questions, the court declined to interfere with respect to six, after UGC submitted that they had been examined by subject experts and that no apparent error had been demonstrated. It observed that the disputes involved matters of “academic opinion” and were “inferential” in nature, adding that it could neither sit in appeal over the experts’ assessment nor substitute its own opinion for theirs. However, with respect to four other questions justice Singh referred the same to subject experts and directed the expert committee to consider the petitions, grant the petitioners an opportunity of hearing, and pass a reasoned order within three weeks. Out of the four questions, two were from Education-009, one from Urdu and the other one was from Geography
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title_zh: “可能影响候选人排名”：德里高等法院因 reportedly errors 下令复核 UGC-Net 答案键
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 德里高等法院已下令由专家审查用于选拔参加2026年6月UGC-NET考试的考生答案键中的四道答案，并指出答案键中的错误可能影响考生的成绩排名和资格认定。UGC-NET考试于6月22日至6月30日举行，共有约727,506名考生参加，成绩于今年8月公布。 Jasmeet Singh法官在11月5日作出、并于周四发布的裁决中，指示专家委员会在三周内对此事作出决定，称答案键似乎存在错误。另请阅读｜准备参加NET考试？NTA解释UGC-NET与CSIR-UGC NET有何不同——查看资格要求、考试模式 “此类错误不应由考生承担。在竞争性考试中，错误的答案键会影响排名和资格认定，因为依据答案键授予的分数决定考生的成绩位次，以及考生能否达到合格分数线；甚至单科一分都可能决定考生是否被认定为合格。”法院说道。法院是在审理参加UGC-NET考试的考生提交的五份请愿时作出该命令的；这些请愿对临时答案键与最终答案键中10道答案的差异提出异议。2026年6月UGC-NET考试引发了多起争议，考生质疑试卷存在错误、涉嫌重复出题以及答案键前后不一致。英语科目尤其受到批评，据报道，其150道题中有67道重复选自2024年考试。针对英语、商业与和社会学科目提出的申诉，促使NTA于2026年9月重新举行考试。另请阅读｜NTA将招聘A组和B组职位，申请人可访问nta.ac.net申请主任及其他职位 在就10道存在争议的题目作出的命令中，针对其中六道题，法院拒绝干预；此前UGC提交称，这些题目已由学科专家审查，且未能证明存在明显错误。法院指出，争议涉及“学术意见”，性质上属于“推断性”问题，并补充称，法院既不能对专家评估提出上诉，也不能以自身意见取代专家意见。然而，针对另外四道题，Singh法官将同一事项交由学科专家审查，并指示专家委员会审议相关请愿，给予请愿人陈述意见的机会，并在三周内作出有理据的决定。这四道题中，两道来自Education-009，一道来自乌尔都语，另一道来自地理学

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111402.title_zh: 野……“必须清零”……与“今后要求增加拨款”……未来基金之争
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111402.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）朴秀允、崔平川记者：朝野双方围绕国会预算结算特别委员会预算小组审议下年度预算案和基金案的实质“削减”，继续就未来应对基金是否合理展开攻防。共同民主党李用宇发言人当天在书面简报会上指出：“国民党方面主张未来应对基金应首先偿还国家债务，因此要求全额削减；但对基金中列入的项目却要求增加预算。”该发言人批评道：“基金要取消，但自己选区的预算却必须增加，这是什么道理？国民党前后不一、彼此矛盾的预算算法实在难看。”他继续说：“李珍淑议员要求将列入未来应对基金的大邱庆北科学技术院研究运营费增加8亿韩元，赵承焕议员则要求将同一基金的近海渔船现代化支援项目增加384亿韩元。既然承认确有必要的项目，为何又把整个基金当作政治攻击目标呢？”他还说：“国民党应停止前后不一地做预算小动作，把用于场外集会的力量投入到国会预算审议中。国民明年的生计不能成为落实党的口号而讨价还价的筹码。”对此，国民党院内首席代表崔殷锡发表评论，谴责未来应对基金削弱了国会的预算控制力度。崔代表表示：“如果税收比预期收得更多，理应像滚雪球般不断膨胀的国家债务应率先削减。然而，政府不但没有偿还债务，反而把超额税收另行积存在基金中，还试图在尽量削弱国会事前监督的情况下，扩大资金注入和动用的权限。”他强调说：“执政党内部甚至也出现声音，认为政府裁量权过大，需要修改政府方案。国会不能只是摆设，对政府任意支配国民税收用途和规模的这种结构不能置之不理。”他还提到：“不能仅以‘未来应对基金’之名，就让国民税收沦为政府装点门面的钱。如果无法证明其必要性，就应全面撤销设立该基金。”本报道通过KakaoTalk okjebo发送。版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载、翻印及用于人工智能学习和应用。2026年11月14日10时30分发布。（首尔=韩联社）申贤宇记者：财政经济部长兼副总理李炯日于4日在国会预算结算特别委员会全体会议举行的下年度预算案审查综合政策质询中，回答共同民主党议员金南俊的质询。2026.11.4 nowwego@yna.co.kr

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111401.title: "APEC 계기 미중러 정상회담 19일 개최…북한 논의 가능성"(종합)
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111401.summary: (워싱턴=연합뉴스) 백나리 특파원 = 미국과 중국, 러시아 정상이 19일(현지시간) 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의를 계기로 만나 3자 회담을 할 것이라고 미 매체 뉴욕포스트가 13일 보도했다. APEC 정상회의를 앞두고 최근 이뤄진 마코 루비오 미 국무장관과 왕이 중국 외교부장의 통화 이후 국무부는 발표문에서 "평화와 비핵화 같은 목표를 증진하기 위한 정상 차원의 의미 있는 논의의 중요성에 뜻을 같이했다"며 미중러 정상회담에 대한 기대감을 표명하기도 했다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111401.summary_zh: （华盛顿＝韩联社）特派记者白娜里＝美国、中国和俄罗斯三国领导人将于19日（当地时间）借亚洲太平洋经济合作组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议之机举行三方会谈。韩国《纽约邮报》旗下网站New York Post于13日报道了这一消息。APEC领导人非正式会议召开前，美国国务卿马科·鲁比奥近日与中国外交部长王毅通完电话后，美国国务院在声明中表示，美中俄三方领导人会议“共同认同了就和平与无核化等目标加强领导人层面有意义讨论的重要性”，并对三国领导人会谈寄予期待。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111401.body: (워싱턴=연합뉴스) 백나리 특파원 = 미국과 중국, 러시아 정상이 19일(현지시간) 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의를 계기로 만나 3자 회담을 할 것이라고 미 매체 뉴욕포스트가 13일 보도했다. 이 매체는 백악관 당국자를 인용해 미중러 정상회담에서 북한 문제가 논의될 수도 있다고 했다. 북미대화 재개에 관심을 두고 있는 트럼프 대통령이 시진핑 중국 국가주석과 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령에게 협조를 요청할지 주목된다. 뉴욕포스트는 미중러 정상회담의 의제가 대체로 핵군축 협정 마련에 맞춰질 것으로 예상된다면서 백악관 당국자를 인용, 이란전쟁과 북한도 논의될 가능성이 있다고 전했다. 미중러 정상회담은 전례가 없다. 성사된다면 현대 외교사의 중대 이벤트가 될 수밖에 없어서 일각에서는 2차 세계대전 말기 미국·영국·소련 정상이 전후 국제질서를 논의한 얄타회담에 비유한다. APEC 정상회의를 앞두고 최근 이뤄진 마코 루비오 미 국무장관과 왕이 중국 외교부장의 통화 이후 국무부는 발표문에서 "평화와 비핵화 같은 목표를 증진하기 위한 정상 차원의 의미 있는 논의의 중요성에 뜻을 같이했다"며 미중러 정상회담에 대한 기대감을 표명하기도 했다. 미국의 관심은 일단 미중러 정상회담을 통한 핵군축 협정 마련에 있는 것으로 보인다. 미국과 러시아 간 핵군축을 위한 신전략무기감축조약(New START)는 지난 2월 만료된 상태이고 중국을 포괄하는 핵군축 협정은 현재 없다. 미중러 간 핵군축 합의가 도출된다면 트럼프 대통령에게는 엄청난 성과다. 중간선거 참패로 국내적 입지가 크게 좁아진 트럼프 대통령에게는 대대적으로 홍보할 수 있는 외교적 성과가 될 수 있다. 다만 푸틴 대통령의 관심은 미중러 정상이 모여 우크라이나 전쟁 종식을 논의하는 데 있는 상황이다. 중국은 자국의 핵전력 수준이 미국이나 러시아에 크게 미치지 못한다며 핵군축 협정에 중국이 포함되는 데 부정적이다. 백악관 당국자의 입에서 '가능성' 수준으로 언급된 만큼 미중러 간 의제 정리가 이뤄졌다기보다는 미국의 희망이 담긴 발언으로 볼 수 있다는 관측이 나온다. 트럼프 대통령이 미중러 정상회담 자리에서 북미대화 재개와 북한의 무력도발 자제를 위한 협조를 요청할지가 가장 큰 관심사다. 트럼프 대통령은 연내 김정은 북한 국무위원장과 만나고 싶다는 뜻을 공개적으로 피력해왔다. 트럼프 대통령은 북한과 러시아의 군사협력 강화 견제도 염두에 두고 있을 가능성이 있다. 우크라이나 전쟁 파병을 통한 러시아와의 군사적 밀착으로 미국과의 대화에 나설 북한의 유인이 줄어든 상태다. 미중러 정상회담에서의 '비핵화' 논의를 내세우고 있는 트럼프 대통령이 북한 비핵화를 제시할지는 미지수다. 북한은 비핵화 논의가 불가하다고 거듭 선을 긋고 있고 트럼프 대통령도 북미대화의 목표가 비핵화냐는 질문에 "그 얘기 하고 싶지 않다"고 답변을 회피한 바 있다. 시 주석과 푸틴 대통령, 김 위원장은 작년 9월 중국 베이징 톈안먼 망루에 함께 오르며 북중러 반미 연대를 과시했고 시 주석과 푸틴 대통령의 지난 5월 정상회담 공동성명에는 대북 제재에 반대한다는 입장만 들어갔을 뿐 '북한 비핵화'는 빠졌다. 그러나 북러 밀착 강화는 중국에도 부담스러운 요소다. 북한의 핵무력 증강이 한반도의 긴장을 고조시킬 수 있다는 점도 시 주석에겐 신경 쓰이는 지점이다. 이 때문에 미중러 정상회담 개최가 성사될 경우 북한에 대한 이해관계가 서로 다른 세 강대국이 논의 방향을 어떻게 잡아나갈지에 관심이 집중된다. 논의 결과에 따라 한반도 안보에도 상당한 영향을 미칠 가능성이 크기 때문에 한국 정부 역시 미중러 정상이 만나 한반도 관련 논의를 할 가능성을 예의주시하고 있다. 미중러 정상회담에서는 우크라이나 전쟁과 이란전쟁 종식 방안도 논의될 수 있다. 트럼프 대통령이 이란과의 합의가 필요 없다며 경제적 압박을 통한 이란 붕괴로 선회하는 모습을 보이는 상황에서 중국과 러시아에 협조 강화를 요구할 수 있다는 전망이 나온다. 미중러 3자 정상회의는 애초 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령이 우크라이나 전쟁 종식을 논의하자면서 거론했다. 중국은 3자 정상회의를 통한 핵 군축 논의 등을 반기지 않고 있어서 회담이 성사되더라도 형식적 논의에 그칠 수 있다는 관측이 일찍부터 제기됐다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/14 08:31 송고 2026년11월14일 08시31분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111401.title_zh: “亚太经合组织期间举行中俄领导人会晤……可能讨论朝鲜问题”（综合报道）
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111401.body_zh:
（华盛顿＝韩联社）驻外记者白娜丽＝美国、中国和俄罗斯三国领导人将于19日（当地时间）借亚洲太平洋经济合作组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议之机举行三方会谈。《纽约邮报》13日报道了这一消息。该媒体援引白宫官员的话称，美中俄领导人会谈也可能讨论朝鲜问题。值得关注的是，美国总统特朗普是否将请求中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京协助推进改善美朝关系。《纽约邮报》预计，美中俄领导人会谈的议题大体将围绕达成核军控协议展开，并援引白宫官员的话报道称，伊朗战争和朝鲜问题也有可能得到讨论。

美中俄领导人会谈将前所未有。如果会谈得以举行，必然会成为现代外交史上的重大事件，因此有人将其与第二次世界大战末期美国、英国和苏联领导人讨论战后国际秩序的雅尔塔会议相提并论。在亚太经合组织领导人非正式会议召开前，美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥与中国外交部长王毅 recently 通了电话。通话后，美国国务院在声明中表示：“双方一致认为，为推进和平与无核化等目标，领导人层面的实质性讨论十分重要。”这表明美国对美中俄领导人会谈抱有期待。

目前看来，美国的关注重点首先是通过美中俄领导人会谈促成核军控协议。美国与俄罗斯之间的核军控新战略武器削减条约（New START）已于今年2月到期，而目前并不存在涵盖中国的核军控协议。如果美中俄能够达成核军控协议，对特朗普总统而言将是非凡成就。对于在中期选举中惨败、国内政治空间大幅收缩的特朗普总统来说，这可能成为一项可以大力宣传的外交成果。

不过，普京总统的关注点目前在于利用美中俄领导人聚会的机会讨论结束乌克兰战争。中国认为本国核力量规模远不及美国或俄罗斯，因此对将中国纳入核军控协议持否定态度。由于白宫官员仅以“可能性”的程度提及此事，有观察认为，这番话与其说是已经梳理了美中俄之间的议程，不如说是包含美国愿望的表态。

最大的关注点在于，特朗普总统是否会在美中俄领导人会谈场合请求各方合作，以恢复改善美朝关系，并劝朝鲜克制军事挑衅。特朗普总统此前曾公开表示，希望在年内会见朝鲜国务委员金正恩。他还可能把遏制朝鲜与俄罗斯加强军事合作纳入考虑。由于朝鲜正通过派兵参与乌克兰战争加强与俄罗斯的军事联系，其与美国对话的诱因已经减少。特朗普总统在美中俄领导人会谈中提出“无核化”议题，但是否会提出朝鲜无核化仍不得而知。朝鲜屡次划出底线，称无法讨论无核化问题；特朗普总统面对有关改善美朝关系的目标是否为无核化的提问时，也曾以“我不想谈这个话题”回避作答。

习近平主席、普京总统和金正恩去年9月共同登上北京天安门城楼，展示了中朝俄三国联合反美的态势；习近平主席与普京总统今年5月会晤后的联合声明中也仅写入了反对对朝制裁的立场，并未提及“朝鲜无核化”。然而，加强朝鲜与俄罗斯的密切关系，也给中国带来令人担忧的因素。朝鲜增强核武力可能加剧半岛紧张局势，这一点同样令习近平主席在意。正因如此，如果美中俄领导人会谈得以举行，外界将关注三个利益诉求各异的大国将如何确定讨论方向。

讨论结果可能对半岛安全产生重大影响，因此韩国政府也留意美中俄领导人是否会就半岛相关问题展开讨论。美中俄领导人会谈还可能讨论乌克兰战争和结束伊朗战争的方案。在特朗普总统表示不需要与伊朗达成协议，并展现希望通过经济施压迫垮伊朗的态势之际，有预期认为，他可能要求中国和俄罗斯加强合作。

美中俄三方领导人会议最初由俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京提出，当时他表示要讨论结束乌克兰战争。中国并不反对通过三方领导人会议讨论核军控等议题，因此很早就有人指出，即使会谈得以举行，也可能流于形式化讨论。

Police said petrol but no explosives were found during searches of vans near the base. Two men have been charged by the Crown Prosecution Service over their alleged involvement in the incident. While Iran denied any responsibility, the US removed all of its bombers from the base in October. https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111312.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 조승한 기자 = 어린 시절 한국전쟁을 경험한 기업 최고경영자(CEO)들이 기업 매출 감소에 다른 CEO보다 직원 감축에 훨씬 적극적으로 나선 것으로 나타났다. 13일 과학기술계에 따르면 조지메이슨대 한국캠퍼스 경영대학원 조은혜·이정화 교수 연구팀은 최근 국제학술지 '경제연구 저널'에 이런 연구 결과를 발표했다. 조 교수의 할아버지는 한국전쟁 참전 용사였고, 이 교수의 아버지도 한국 육군 중령으로 전역해 전쟁과 군 복무에 대한 이야기를 접하면서 자연스럽게 관심으로 이어졌다는 것이다. 연구팀은 2002년부터 2023년까지 한국 상장기업 재무 데이터 2만4천703건을 CEO 연령별로 분류한 다음 한국전쟁 이전 출생한 CEO들의 기업 활동을 분석했다. 전쟁에 노출된 CEO들이 자극제가 될 수 있는 매출 감소를 겪었을 때 더 강한 감정적 반응을 보여 큰 규모의 인력 감축을 수행하는지 분석했다. 그 결과 실제로 전쟁 경험이 있는 CEO가 이끈 한국 기업은 매출 호황기에 고용을 22% 덜 늘리고, 불황기에는 106% 더 감원하는 경향을 보인 것으로 나타났다. 이런 효과는 4~15세 사이 한국전쟁을 경험해 기억을 가진 CEO들에게 집중적으로 나타났다고 연구팀은 설명했다. 연구팀은 "어린 시절 전쟁에 노출되면 부정적인 위험에 대한 민감도가 높아질 수 있다는 것"이라며 "전쟁은 불확실성, 상실, 자원 부족으로 특징지어지는 극단적인 환경이며, 성장기에 그런 불안정성에 노출되는 것은 나중의 삶에서 위협을 인식하고 압박 속에서 결정을 내리는 방식에 영향을 미칠 수 있다"고 말했다. 이런 결과가 한 세대의 사고방식이나 노화 영향이 아닌 성장기 전쟁 노출 경험 영향을 확인하기 위해 연구팀은 CEO들의 출생 지역을 분석했다. 그 결과 CEO들의 고용 유지율 변화로 측정한 위험 민감도가 그들이 성장한 시기 거주 지역에서 발생한 한국전쟁 민간인 사상자 수와 상관관계가 있는 것으로 나타났다. 연구팀은 "성장기의 경험이 수십 년 후 경영상의 의사 결정에 지속적인 영향을 미칠 수 있다는 것"이라며 "전쟁이 예외적인 경우라 생각하지 않고, 다른 심각한 성장기 경험 또한 지도자들이 위험을 인식하고 나중에 의사결정을 내리는 방식에 지속적인 영향을 미칠 가능성이 있다"고 설명했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/14 08:00 송고 2026년11월14일 08시00분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111312.title_zh: [易科学] 经历战争的首席执行官：不景气到来就进一步裁员
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111312.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）韩胜汉记者＝一项研究发现，童年时期经历韩国战争的企业首席执行官（CEO）在企业营收下滑时，比其他CEO更积极地削减员工。13日，科学技术界消息人士称，乔治梅森大学韩国校区经营大学院教授赵恩慧和李正焕的研究团队近日在国际学术期刊《经济研究杂志》上发表了这一研究成果。赵教授的祖父是韩国战争参战老兵，该教授的父亲也曾以韩国陆军中校退役；在接触战争及军旅生活的相关故事后，他自然而然地对此产生了研究兴趣。研究团队将2002年至2023年韩国上市公司共计24,703份财务数据按CEO年龄分类，随后分析朝鲜战争前出生的CEO所在企业的经营活动，并考察经历战争的CEO在遭遇可能带来刺激的营收下降时，是否会表现出更强烈的情绪反应并实施大规模裁员。结果显示，由有战争经历的CEO领导的韩国企业，在营收繁荣期增加就业的比例低22%，在衰退期裁员的比例则高出106%。研究团队解释道，这种影响主要集中在4至15岁期间经历韩国战争并对此留有记忆的CEO身上。研究团队表示：“童年时期接触战争，可能会提高人们对负面风险的敏感度。”并称：“战争是一种以不确定性、损失和资源匮乏为特征的极端环境，在成长阶段暴露于这种不稳定之中，可能会影响人们日后感知威胁以及在压力下作出决定的方式。”为确认这些结果并非源自某一世代的思维方式或老龄化影响，而是成长阶段接触战争经历所产生的影响，研究团队还分析了CEO的出生地区。结果显示，以CEO留用率变化衡量的风险敏感度，与其成长时期居住地区在韩国战争中出现的平民伤亡人数呈相关性。研究团队解释道：“成长阶段的经历可能在数十年后持续影响经营决策。”并称：“即使不认为战争是例外情况，其他严重的成长阶段经历也可能持续影响领导者识别风险以及日后作出决策的方式。”如需举报请使用KakaoTalk，账号为okjebo。版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、发行及用于AI训练或使用。2026年11月14日08:00发送。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111308.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 이보배 기자 = 지난 한 주(11월 8∼13일)에는 이재명 정부의 두 번째 법무부 장관 후보자로 지명된 이용철 방위사업청장과 불륜 파문으로 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)에서 물러난 젠슨 황 창업자에게 독자들의 관심이 집중됐다. 아랍에미리트(UAE) 국적을 취득해 한국 국적을 상실한 사실이 뒤늦게 알려진 황우석 전 서울대 교수 등도 주요 관심 인물로 꼽혔다. 이 후보자는 이 대통령이 2010년 성남시장 당선 직전 변호사로 몸담았던 법무법인 새길의 창립 멤버로, 당시 이 대통령과 민사 6건·행정 1건 등 총 7건의 사건을 공동 수임한 바 있다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111308.summary_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者李宝培＝过去一周（11月8日至13日），被提名为李在明政府第二任法务部长候选人的防务事业厅厅长李镐哲，以及因不端风波辞去NVIDIA首席执行官（CEO）职务的Jen-Hsun Huang创始人，吸引了读者的关注。黄宇锡前首尔大学教授等人也因后来才得知其已取得阿拉伯联合酋长国（UAE）国籍并失去韩国国籍而成为主要关注人物。这位候选人曾在李明总统当选京畿道水原市长的前夕，作为律师任职于新GIRL律师事务所，并参与创立该所。当时，他与李总统共同代理了7起案件，包括6起民事案件和1起行政案件。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111308.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 이보배 기자 = 지난 한 주(11월 8∼13일)에는 이재명 정부의 두 번째 법무부 장관 후보자로 지명된 이용철 방위사업청장과 불륜 파문으로 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)에서 물러난 젠슨 황 창업자에게 독자들의 관심이 집중됐다. 아랍에미리트(UAE) 국적을 취득해 한국 국적을 상실한 사실이 뒤늦게 알려진 황우석 전 서울대 교수 등도 주요 관심 인물로 꼽혔다. 이 후보자는 이 대통령이 2010년 성남시장 당선 직전 변호사로 몸담았던 법무법인 새길의 창립 멤버로, 당시 이 대통령과 민사 6건·행정 1건 등 총 7건의 사건을 공동 수임한 바 있다. 이후 2011년 7월부터 2015년 4월까지는 성남시 산하 성남산업진흥재단(현 성남산업진흥원) 대표이사를 지냈다. 재단은 그의 취임 후 조직개편을 통해 대장동·위례신도시의 산업육성 전략 수립과 관련 사업 발굴을 추진했다. 이와 관련해 야권 일각에서는 이 후보자가 대장동 개발 비리의 '설계자'라고 주장하지만, 이 후보자는 개발 사업에 관여하지 않았다는 입장이다. 이 대통령 형사사건의 공소취소 논란에 대해서는 11일 인사청문회 준비단 첫 출근길에 "지금은 진상 규명에 집중할 때이고 나머지는 법과 원칙에 따라야 한다는 기존 입장에 변화는 없다"고 밝혔다. 엔비디아를 세계 인공지능(AI) 반도체 시장의 선두 기업으로 키워낸 입지전적 인물이지만, 잇따른 불륜 스캔들 끝에 1993년 회사를 공동 창업한 지 33년 만에 전격 퇴진했다. 엔비디아 이사회는 12일(현지시간) 성명을 내고 황 CEO가 사장과 CEO, 이사회 이사직에서 즉각 사임한다고 밝혔다. 황 전 CEO는 중국 스파이로 의심받는 앨리스 황(중국명 황러) 전 메가스피드 임원과의 불륜 의혹이 불거지자 지난 8일 "아내에게 불충실했다"며 혼외 관계를 시인했다. 앨리스 황이 황 전 CEO와의 관계를 이용해 최소 75억 달러(약 10조원) 규모의 엔비디아 AI 칩을 중국 주요 기술기업들이 몰래 활용할 수 있도록 도왔다는 미국 매체 보도도 나왔다. 황 전 CEO 사임 여파로 12일(현지시간) 엔비디아 주가는 4.34% 하락 마감했고, 뉴욕증시 주요 지수도 일제히 내렸다. 지역구 당원 등이 참여하는 단체 대화방에서 국회 사진·영상 기자들을 '하이에나 떼'로 지칭한 사실이 드러나 거센 비판을 받고 지난 11일 사과했다. 그는 지난 5일 단체 대화방에 취재 중인 기자들의 사진을 올리며 "하이에나 떼들", "어떻게든 이간 영상 찍으려 저러고 있다"고 적었다. 논란이 일자 페이스북에 "표현이 과하고 적절하지 못했음을 인정하고 사과드린다"고 밝힌 데 이어 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 공식 사과했다. 12일에는 지난달 지역구 비공개 간담회에서 "이재명 대통령이 당 대표 시절 윤석열 전 대통령 탄핵에 반대했다", "하야하는 쪽으로 잘해보자는 입장이었다"고 말했다는 보도가 나왔다. 청와대는 강유정 수석대변인 명의로 "최 의원의 전언은 사실무근"이라며 강한 유감을 표했고, 최 의원은 "대통령께서는 내란 후 일관되게 윤석열 탄핵을 주장·관철시키셨다"며 일문일답 과정에서 헷갈렸다고 사과했다. 최 최고위원은 13일 오전 단독 기자회견을 통해 자신의 발언에 대해 재차 해명했지만 당 윤리감찰단의 감찰 조사를 지시한 김민석 민주당 대표의 결정에 대해서는 친청(친정청래)계인 이성윤·한민수 최고위원과 공동기자회견을 열어 "남의 눈에 티끌만 문제 삼는 격"이라고 비판했다. UAE에서 활동 중인 황우석 전 서울대 교수가 UAE 국적을 취득해 한국 국적을 상실한 사실이 뒤늦게 알려지며 화제를 모았다. 법무부 청주 출입국·외국인사무소는 황 전 교수가 올해 4월 9일 UAE 국적을 취득해 한국 국적을 상실했다고 지난 8월 고시했다. 다만 황 전 교수는 한 언론과의 인터뷰에서 "한국 국적 회복 신청을 했고, 법무부 심사 결과를 기다리고 있다"고 밝혔다. 과거 동물 복제 연구로 이름을 알린 그는 2004∼2005년 미국 과학저널 '사이언스'에 발표한 줄기세포 관련 논문이 조작된 것으로 드러나 큰 파장을 일으켰다. 이후 연구비 횡령 등 혐의로 기소돼 2014년 징역 1년 6개월에 집행유예 2년이 확정됐고, 서울대와의 소송 끝에 2015년 파면이 확정됐다. 홍익표 전 청와대 정무수석의 사의 표명에 따라 주택도시보증공사(HUG) 사장에서 후임 정무수석으로 발탁됐다. 임광현 대통령비서실장은 그가 부산 지역 재선 국회의원 출신이자 민주당 최고위원과 수석대변인을 지낸 이력을 언급하며 "소통과 통합의 가치를 실천해 온 정치인"이라고 인선 배경을 설명했다. 최 수석은 지난 10일 김민석 민주당 대표를 찾아 "당·정·청이 하나 되고 소통을 강화해 그 성과가 민생과 국정의 성과로 이어지도록 최선을 다하겠다"고 했다. 같은 날 국민의힘 정점식 원내대표에게는 "형식이나 내용을 떠나 언제든 야당 지도부가 청와대에 오셔서 허심탄회한 대화의 복원이 되길 바란다"고 말했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/14 08:00 송고 2026년11월14일 08시00분 송고 (서울=연합뉴스) 서명곤 기자 = 이용철 법무부 장관 후보자가 13일 서울 송파구 서울출입국·외국인청에 마련된 인사청문회 준비단 사무실로 출근하고 있다. 2026.11.13 seephoto@yna.co.kr (서울=연합뉴스) 더불어민주당 최민희 최고위원이 11일 기자들에 대한 표현 관련 사과를 마친 후 국회 소통관에서 나오고 있다. 최 최고위원은 지난 5일 지역구 단체 대화방에 국회 사진·영상 기자들이 취재 중인 사진을 올리며 "하이에나 떼들", "어떻게든 이간 영상 찍으려 저러고 있다"고 적었다. 2026.11.11 [국회사진기자단] xyz@yna.co.kr (서울=연합뉴스) 신현우 기자 = 최인호 청와대 정무수석비서관이 10일 국회에서 취임 인사차 국민의힘 정점식 원내대표를 예방, 인사말하고 있다. 2026.11.10 nowwego@yna.co.kr
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111308.title_zh: [本周关注人物] 提名“司法部长候选人”李在镕与因“逃兵”获释的黄 jenkson
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111308.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者李宝培＝过去一周（11月8日至13日），读者关注的目光集中于被提名为李在明政府第二任法务部长候选人的防务事业厅厅长李镒哲，以及因不伦丑闻从英伟达首席执行官（CEO）职位上卸任的创始人黄仁勋。黄仁勋取得阿拉伯联合酋长国（UAE）国籍、失去韩国国籍的事宜也是近日才被曝出，前首尔大学教授黄宇锡等人也被列为主要关注人物。这名候选人还是总统律师事务“新路”的创始成员之一；在李总统于2010年当选城南市长前不久，他曾以律师身份参与该事务所，并当时与李总统共同承办了6起民事案件、1起行政案件等共7起案件。此后，从2011年7月至2015年4月，他担任城南市下属城南产业振兴财团（现城南产业振兴院）代表理事。该财团在他上任后通过组织重组，推进大庄洞、威路线新城的产业发展战略制定以及相关项目开发工作。就此，野党人士有人主张这名候选人是大庄洞开发腐败案的“设计者”，但该候选人表示自己并未参与开发项目。对于李总统刑事案件撤销公诉争议，他于11日前往人事听证准备组办公室上班时表示：“现在是集中查明真相的时候，其余事情应依照法律和原则处理，我们一贯的立场没有变化。”他原本是把英伟达打造成全球人工智能（AI）半导体市场领军企业的人物，却因接连发生不伦丑闻，在与公司共同创业33年后全面退出。英伟达董事会于当地时间12日发表声明称，黄CEO立即辞去董事长兼CEO及董事会董事职务。黄前CEO在与中国间谍嫌疑人、前美光高管黄莉（中文名黄莉）的绯闻曝光后，于本月8日承认“对妻子不忠”，称自己存在婚外关系。美国媒体还报道称，黄莉利用与黄前CEO的关系，帮助中国主要科技企业秘密使用至少75亿美元（约10万亿韩元）规模的英伟达AI芯片。受黄前CEO辞职影响，英伟达股价于当地时间12日收跌4.34%，纽约股市主要指数也集体下挫。地方选区党员等人士参与的群聊中，国会摄影和影像记者被称作“母鸡群”，此事曝光后引发强烈批评，相关人士于本月11日道歉。本月5日，他将正在采访的记者照片上传至群聊并写道：“母鸡群”“他们正想方设法拍摄挑拨离间的视频”。争议发生后，他在Facebook上表示“承认自己的表达过于夸张且不恰当，并予以道歉”，随后在国会举行记者会，正式道歉。12日有报道称，他在上个月地方选区非公开恳谈会上说，“李在明总统担任党代表时反对弹劾尹锡悦前总统”，“他的立场是看看能否向那边靠拢”。青瓦台以首席副发言人姜由祯名义表示，“崔议员的转述毫无根据”，并表达了强烈遗憾；崔议员则表示：“总统在内乱发生后始终一贯主张并推动弹劾尹锡悦”，并为在一问一答过程中表述混乱而道歉。崔最高委员于13日上午单独举行记者会，再次就自己的发言作出解释；但对于民主党党魁金民锡决定指示党内伦理监察团展开监察调查一事，他与亲清（亲青）系统的李性允、韩民秀最高委员共同举行记者会，批评此举是“只在挑别人眼里的细枝末节做文章”。正在UAE活动的黄前首尔大学教授取得UAE国籍、失去韩国国籍的消息曝光后，成为舆论焦点。法务部清州出入境·外国人事务室于上月8日公布，黄前教授于今年4月9日取得UAE国籍并失去韩国国籍。不过，黄前教授在接受一家媒体采访时表示：“我已申请恢复韩国国籍，正在等待法务部的审查结果。”他早年因动物克隆研究而成名，2004年至2005年在美国科学期刊《科学》发表的干细胞相关论文被曝存在造假，引发巨大风波。此后，他因涉嫌挪用研究费等罪名被起诉，缓刑2年、判处有期徒刑1年6个月的判决最终确定；在与首尔大学的诉讼结束后，他于2015年被开除的处分最终确定。奉前青瓦台政务首席洪益表的辞呈，住房城市保证公社（HUG）社长被提名为继任政务首席。总统秘书室室长林光贤提及他出身于釜山地区连任国会议员，并曾任民主党最高委员和首席副发言人的履历，介绍其入选背景称：“他是一位始终践行沟通与团结价值的政治人物。”崔首席于本月10日前往拜访民主党党魁金民锡，并表示：“党、政府、青瓦台将融为一体，加强沟通，为使其成果转化为民生和国政成果而努力。”同一天，他向国民力量院内代表郑镇式表示：“不论形式还是内容，我都希望无论何时野党领导层都能来到青瓦台，让恢复坦诚对话的恳谈得以实现。”报道：KakaoTalk https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111316.title: "1년차 교사는 밤 9시 넘어 퇴근" 강요한 교장에 2심 "징계 정당"
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111316.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 김빛나 기자 = 초등학교 교장이 1년 차 교사들에게 밤늦게까지 근무하도록 강요한 데 따른 징계 처분은 정당하다는 항소심 판단이 나왔다. 14일 법조계에 따르면 서울고법 행정4-1부(박연욱 이광만 문광섭 부장판사)는 A씨가 교육부 장관을 상대로 "견책 처분을 취소해달라"며 낸 소송에서 1심과 같이 원고 패소로 판결했다. 대구 지역 초등학교 교장인 A씨는 신규 전입 교사(1년차)들에게 야간 근무를 강요하고 청소와 행사 준비 등을 지시한 이유로 2024년 11월 견책 처분을 받았다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111316.summary_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者金_BITNA＝上诉法院裁定，对一名小学校长因强迫入职第一年的教师深夜工作而作出的纪律处分是正当的。司法界14日称，首尔高等法院行政4-1庭（朴延旭、李光满、文光锡部长法官）在A某以教育部长为被告、请求“取消谴责处分”的诉讼中作出与一审相同的判决，驳回原告请求。A某是大邱地区一所小学的校长，因强迫新入职教师（入职第一年）从事夜间工作，并要求他们打扫卫生和筹备活动等，于2024年11月受到谴责处分。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111316.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 김빛나 기자 = 초등학교 교장이 1년 차 교사들에게 밤늦게까지 근무하도록 강요한 데 따른 징계 처분은 정당하다는 항소심 판단이 나왔다. 14일 법조계에 따르면 서울고법 행정4-1부(박연욱 이광만 문광섭 부장판사)는 A씨가 교육부 장관을 상대로 "견책 처분을 취소해달라"며 낸 소송에서 1심과 같이 원고 패소로 판결했다. 대구 지역 초등학교 교장인 A씨는 신규 전입 교사(1년차)들에게 야간 근무를 강요하고 청소와 행사 준비 등을 지시한 이유로 2024년 11월 견책 처분을 받았다. 교육공무원 특별징계위원회 조사에 따르면 A씨는 2024년 2월 교무부장 등 교사들이 모인 자리에서 "1년 차는 모두 늦게까지 남게 해야 한다"고 말했다. 같은 날 교감 등이 참석한 회의에서도 "당분간 신규 전입 교사 모두 오후 9시 30분까지 근무한 뒤 문단속을 하고 퇴근하라"고 지시했다. A씨는 근무 경력이 짧은 교사가 청소와 행사 준비 등을 맡는 것이 전통이라며 신규 전입 교사들에게 관련 업무를 지시하기도 했다. 이 같은 사실은 같은 해 6월 온라인 커뮤니티에 '직장 내 괴롭힘을 도저히 참을 수 없다'는 내용의 폭로 글이 올라오면서 세상에 알려졌다. 재판부는 "1년 차 교사도 책임감을 가지고 학교 운영에 참여하자는 취지였다"는 A씨의 주장을 받아들이지 않았다. 재판부는 교사들의 증언 등을 토대로 A씨가 교사들이 모인 자리에서 "기강을 세워야 한다"고 말한 점에 주목했다. 당시 동석자가 1년차 교사들이 늦게까지 남아야 하는 이유를 묻자 "일이야 만들면 된다"고 답한 점도 언급했다. 재판부는 "교장인 원고가 자신의 업무상 지위를 이용해 1년 차 교사들에게 의무 없는 초과근무를 종용했다"며 "학교의 원활한 운영이 목적이었다고 해도 상급자가 하급자의 의사에 반해 초과근무를 종용한 것은 정당화되기 어렵다"고 지적했다. 이어 "A씨는 소속 교직원을 지휘·감독하고 교사와 학생에게 모범을 보여야 할 고위직 교육공무원"이라며 "근무 경력이 짧은 교사에게 궂은일을 맡기는 부당한 관행을 알면서도 이를 유지하기 위해 징계 사유에 해당하는 행위를 했다"고 지적했다. 징계로 교장 중임이 어려워졌다는 A씨 주장에 대해서도 "견책 처분을 받았다는 이유만으로 교장을 다시 맡을 수 없게 되는 것은 아니다"라며 원고의 청구를 기각했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/14 08:00 송고 2026년11월14일 08시00분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111316.title_zh: “一年级教师晚上9点以后下班”被强令的校长二审获“处分正当”判决
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111316.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者 김빛나 = 针对某小学校长强迫入职满1年的教师深夜工作的纪律处分是否正当，上诉法院作出肯定裁决。据14日司法界消息，首尔高等法院行政4-1庭（部长法官朴연욱、李光满、文光燮）就A某以教育部长为被告、请求取消谴责处分的诉讼作出判决，与一审一样，裁定原告败诉。任职于大邱地区某小学的A某，因强迫新入职教师（入职满1年）夜间工作，并要求他们负责清洁和活动准备等工作，于2024年11月受到谴责处分。据教育公务员特别纪律处分委员会调查，A某于2024年2月在教务主任等教师聚集的场合说：“入职满1年的教师都必须留到很晚。”当天，在副校长等人出席的会议上，他又指示：“暂时所有新入职教师都要工作到晚上9点30分，然后锁好门再下班。”A某还以资历较浅的教师传统上要负责清洁和活动准备等工作为由，指派新入职教师承担相关工作。上述事实于同年6月因一篇题为“职场霸凌实在忍无可忍”的爆料帖出现在网络论坛上而为人所知。法院未采纳A某的主张，即其称此举意在让入职满1年的教师也能带着责任感参与学校运营。法院根据教师等人的证言，特别关注了A某在教师聚集的场合所说的“必须严明纪律”。法院还提到，当时有在座者询问入职满1年的教师为何必须留到很晚时，A某回答：“有活儿干就行了。”法院指出：“身为校长的原告利用其职务上的地位，强迫入职满1年的教师从事并非其职责范围内的超时工作。即便目的是确保学校顺畅运营，上级人员违背下级人员意愿强迫超时工作，也难以获得正当性。”法院进一步指出：“A某作为指挥、监督所属教职员工并应为教师和学生作出表率的高级教育公务员，在明知让资历较浅的教师从事繁重工作属于不当惯例的情况下，仍为维持这一惯例而采取了构成纪律处分事由的行为。”针对A某主张纪律处分使其难以继续担任校长一职，法院表示：“不会仅因受到谴责处分，就不能再担任校长。”因此驳回原告的请求。报道请通过KakaoTalk的okjebo获取。版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载、重新发布及用于人工智能学习和利用。2026/11/14 08:00发送，2026年11月14日08时00分发送

https://leadership.ng/presidency-release.summary_zh: 总统府发布了一段视频画面，显示总统博拉·蒂努布在参加星期五主麻礼拜后离开清真寺，此举是为了反驳反对派支持者中流传的关于其行踪的说法。他坚持称，总统府发布的画面显示，蒂努布在参加星期五聚礼后离开了清真寺。
https://leadership.ng/presidency-release.body: The Presidency has released video footage showing President Bola Tinubu leaving a mosque after observing Friday prayers, in a move to counter claims circulating among opposition supporters about his whereabouts. Senior Adviser to the President on Digital and New Media, Otega Ogra shared the footage on his X handle on Friday, describing reports and videos being circulated by opposition supporters as misleading. In the post, Ogra accused the opposition of pushing a false narrative about the President, alleging that videos circulating online featured individuals he described as paid thugs at the mosque. He maintained that the footage released by the Presidency showed Tinubu leaving the mosque after observing the Friday congregational prayers. He added, “Contrary to the narrative being pushed by the opposition, with videos of their alleged paid thugs at the Mosque today, here is footage of Mr. President leaving the mosque after Friday prayers this afternoon.” The presidential aide accompanied the post with a message of support for Tinubu and the country, saying, “God bless our President. https://leadership.ng/presidency-release.body_zh: 总统府发布了一段视频，显示总统博拉·蒂努布在参加星期五礼拜后离开清真寺，以反驳反对派支持者中流传的关于其行踪的说法。总统数字与新媒体高级顾问奥泰加·奥格拉星期五在X账号上分享了这段视频，称反对派支持者传播的相关报道和视频具有误导性。奥格拉在帖子中指责反对派散布有关总统的虚假叙事，声称网上流传的视频出现了他所谓的受雇打手。他坚持表示，总统府发布的画面显示，蒂努布在参加星期五聚礼后离开了清真寺。他补充道：“与反对派散布的说法相反，他们今天在清真寺拍摄所谓受雇打手的视频。这里是总统先生今天下午参加星期五礼拜后离开清真寺的画面。”这位总统顾问随帖附上对蒂努布和尼日利亚的支持信息，称：“愿上帝保佑我们的总统。愿上帝保佑尼日利亚。”我们掌握前沿资讯。实时报道、独家爆料和独家视角将直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp频道，全天候获取最新消息 →

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body: The First Lady of Nigeria, Senator Oluremi Tinubu, received a rousing welcome from thousands of residents and supporters during her visit to Zamfara State. On Tuesday, the Zamfara State Government hosted the APC North-West Women’s Mega Rally and Empowerment Programme at the Trade Fair Complex in Gusau. The event, led by Zamfara First Lady Huriyya Dauda Lawal, brought together former Zamfara governors, the first ladies of the North-West, ministers and other key All Progressives Congress stakeholders. Before the rally, Senator Tinubu met with the Zamfara State traditional rulers to seek their blessings. In her remarks, Mrs Tinubu described her visit as a powerful expression of solidarity and compassion, as well as a commitment to women’s welfare and advancement, especially for those facing insecurity, poverty and limited economic opportunities. She said, “This is the happiest day of my life. Except for Zamfara, I have been in all 36 states of Nigeria, including the FCT. I have always wanted to come to Zamfara, and today I have fulfilled that. Because it is now easy to come, this is just the beginning; I am coming back again. Mr President is also coming. “Before I start, I want to commiserate with you all for all the lives that were lost; they are very precious to us. May God forgive them, grant them Al-Jannatul Firdaus, and continue to be with us. “Today is Juma’at; we have to be fast; we have empowerment to give to women. This is the only party that empowers during the campaign, and it is not about the campaign; we have been empowering from day one. And that is why it is not politics. “Earlier, I was also given a title in Zamfara, the ‘Jagaban Matan Arewa’ by the Chairman of the Zamfara State Council of Chiefs and Emir of Anka, Alhaji Attahiru Muhammad Ahmad. I thanked all the Emirs. “I love Zamfara. I am happy to be here. Mr President said I should tell you he will continue working for you. Nigeria will continue to prosper, in sha Allah.” Earlier, Governor Dauda Lawal thanked Senator Tinubu for her continued support through the Renewed Hope Initiative, including its Food Outreach Programme. “Your Excellency, Mother of the Nation, your presence today represents more than an official visit. You have set a record in the history of our dear Zamfara State. “Your Excellency, Distinguished ladies and gentlemen, in Zamfara State, we firmly believe that empowering women is not only our responsibility as a government; it is a needed and bankable investment in social and societal morality, economic prosperity, family stability, and sustainable peace. “I assure Your Excellency that Zamfara’s government and people unwaveringly support Mr President’s second term. With the women here and the men supporting them, Zamfara and the North West will deliver for Mr President come January 2027.”
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.title_zh: 扎姆法拉迎宾第一夫人奥卢雷米·蒂努布，举行大型集会；925054
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body_zh:
尼日利亚第一夫人、参议员奥卢雷米·蒂努布在她访问赞法拉州期间，受到数千名居民和支持者的热烈欢迎。周二，赞法拉州政府在古绍的贸易展览中心主办了全进步大会党西北部妇女大型集会暨赋权计划。活动由赞法拉州第一夫人胡里娅·达乌达·拉瓦勒主持，赞法拉州历任州长、西北部各州第一夫人、部长及全进步大会党其他重要人士齐聚一堂。集会前，蒂努布参议员会见赞法拉州传统 ruler，争取他们的祝福。蒂努布夫人在讲话中表示，此次访问有力体现了团结与关怀，也表明政府致力于改善妇女福祉、推动妇女发展，尤其关注那些面临安全局势恶化、贫困和经济机会有限的妇女。她说：“这是我一生中最快乐的一天。除了赞法拉州，我走遍了尼日利亚全部36个州，包括联邦首都区。我一直想来赞法拉州，今天终于实现了。因为现在来这里已经很容易了，所以这才是开始；我还会再来。总统先生也会来。

“开始之前，我想对所有失去生命的人表示深切哀悼；他们的生命对我们非常宝贵。愿真主宽恕他们，赐予他们天堂的福地，并继续庇佑我们。

“今天是主麻日；我们必须抓紧时间；我们还有赋权成果要交给妇女。这是唯一一个在竞选期间为妇女赋权的政党，而且这并不只是竞选活动；我们从第一天起就一直在推动赋权。也正因为如此，这并不只是政治。

“此前，我还被授予了赞法拉州‘Jagaban Matan Arewa’的头衔，授予者是赞法拉州酋长委员会主席兼安卡埃米尔阿塔希鲁·穆罕默德·艾哈迈德。我感谢所有埃米尔。

“我热爱赞法拉州。我很高兴来到这里。总统先生让我告诉你们，他会继续为你们而努力。尼日利亚将继续繁荣，安拉如此。”

此前，达乌达·拉瓦勒州长感谢蒂努布参议员通过“ renewed Hope Initiative ”持续支持赞法拉州，包括该倡议下开展的食物援助计划。她说：“阁下、尼日利亚母后，您今天的到来不仅仅是一次官方访问。您在我们亲爱的赞法拉州历史上树立了典范。

“阁下、尊敬的女士们和先生们，在赞法拉州，我们坚信，赋予妇女权能不仅是政府的责任，也是对社会道德、经济繁荣、家庭稳定和持久和平的一项必要且值得投资的举措。

“我向阁下保证，赞法拉州政府和人民将坚定不移地支持总统先生连任。有了在场的妇女以及支持她们的男士，赞法拉州和西北部将在2027年1月为总统先生交出令人满意的成绩。”

https://leadership.ng/2027-adc-pcc-deman.title: 2027: ADC-PCC Demands Withdrawal Of Tinubu’s ‘All Is Fair In Politics’ Remark
https://leadership.ng/2027-adc-pcc-deman.summary: The African Democratic Congress Presidential Campaign Council (ADC-PCC) has called on President Bola Ahmed Tinubu to publicly withdraw his “All Is Fair in Politics” remark, warning that it could encourage political violence and threaten the nation’s peace and stability ahead of the 2027 general elections.
https://leadership.ng/2027-adc-pcc-deman.summary_zh: 非洲民主大会总统竞选委员会（ADC-PCC）已呼吁总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布公开收回其“政治中一切公平”的言论，并警告称，在2027年大选之前，这番话可能助长政治暴力，威胁国家的和平与稳定。
https://leadership.ng/2027-adc-pcc-deman.body: The African Democratic Congress Presidential Campaign Council (ADC-PCC) has called on President Bola Ahmed Tinubu to publicly withdraw his “All Is Fair in Politics” remark, warning that it could encourage political violence and threaten the nation’s peace and stability ahead of the 2027 general elections. The council also expressed concern over what it described as the President’s silence on alleged inflammatory statements and threats by some governors and chieftains of the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC). In a statement signed by its Director of Media and Publicity, Kola Ologbondiyan, the ADC-PCC urged Tinubu to rise above partisan interests and demonstrate the statesmanship expected of a national leader. It cited former President Goodluck Jonathan’s declaration that no presidential ambition was worth the blood of any Nigerian, urging Tinubu to make a similar commitment to peaceful political engagement. The council criticised the Presidency for allegedly focusing its condemnation of political violence on opposition parties while failing to address accusations against members of the ruling party. It said the President’s remark that “All Is Fair in Politics” was inappropriate for a sitting Head of State, arguing that it could be interpreted as providing cover for thuggery, ballot snatching, intimidation and bloodshed. The ADC-PCC alleged that opposition gatherings had come under attack in Edo, Cross River, Gombe, Lagos, Kebbi and Kaduna states, with campaign materials destroyed and supporters assaulted by suspected APC-sponsored thugs. It, however, accused the Presidency of adopting what it described as diversionary tactics by blaming victims and urging opposition parties to exercise restraint instead of addressing alleged acts of violence within the APC. The council challenged Tinubu to explain why his condemnation of political violence appeared to be directed more at opposition parties than members of his own party. It also questioned the President’s silence over alleged threats by APC governors and inflammatory statements by party officials. Reaffirming its commitment to peaceful and issue-based political engagement, the ADC-PCC said its campaign would focus on addressing the country’s challenges, including hunger, insecurity, unemployment and corruption. It also accused the APC of resorting to political intimidation because it lacked credible solutions to the problems confronting Nigerians. The council consequently demanded that Tinubu publicly withdraw his “All Is Fair in Politics” remark, condemn and call to order APC governors and party officials accused of inciting violence, and direct security agencies to protect all Nigerians without political bias. “ Nigeria belongs to all of us. No political ambition is worth the blood of any Nigerian. “If former President Goodluck Jonathan could make that profound declaration in 2015, President Tinubu has no excuse not to say so and demonstrate the sincerity of his commitment to peace in 2026. “The ADC will not be intimidated. We will continue to campaign peacefully, and in 2027, Nigerians will have the opportunity to vote for competence, integrity and a new beginning,” the statement added. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/2027-adc-pcc-deman.title_zh: 2027年：ADC-PCC要求撤回蒂努布“政治中一切皆公平”的言论
https://leadership.ng/2027-adc-pcc-deman.body_zh: 非洲民主大会党总统竞选委员会（ADC-PCC）呼吁总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布公开收回“政治中一切皆公平”的言论，并警告称，这番言论可能助长政治暴力，威胁国家在2027年大选前的和平与稳定。该委员会还表示关切，称总统对执政的进步大会党（APC）部分州长和酋长涉嫌发表的煽动性言论及威胁保持沉默。在由媒体与公共事务主任科拉·奥洛贡博迪安签署的一份声明中，ADC-PCC敦促蒂努布超越党派利益，展现国家领导人应有的政治风范。声明援引前总统古德勒克·乔纳森关于“任何总统野心都不值得以任何尼日利亚人的鲜血为代价”的表态，敦促蒂努布作出类似承诺，以和平方式参与政治。该委员会批评总统府据称只谴责反对党实施的政治暴力，却不处理针对执政党成员的指控。委员会称，总统“政治中一切皆公平”的言论对在任国家元首而言并不恰当，因为这可能被解读为为暴徒行径、劫掠选票、恐吓和流血事件提供掩护。ADC-PCC指控，反对派集会在埃多、克罗斯河、贡贝、拉各斯、凯比和卡杜纳等州遭到袭击，活动宣传材料被毁，支持者遭到疑似受APC支持的暴徒殴打。不过，该委员会指责总统府采取其所称的转移视线策略，即归咎于受害者，并敦促反对党保持克制，却不处理APC内部涉嫌的暴力行为。该委员会要求蒂努布解释，为何他对政治暴力的谴责似乎更多针对反对党，而不是本党成员。委员会还质疑总统对APC州长涉嫌发出的威胁以及党内官员发表的煽动性言论保持沉默。重申对和平、以议题为导向的政治参与的承诺时，ADC-PCC表示，其竞选活动将聚焦解决国家面临的饥饿、治安恶化、失业和腐败等问题。该委员会还指控APC因缺乏解决尼日利亚人面临问题的可行方案，而诉诸政治恐吓。因此，该委员会要求蒂努布公开收回“政治中一切皆公平”的言论，谴责并要求制止被指控煽动暴力的APC州长和党内官员，同时指示安全机构不带政治偏见地保护所有尼日利亚人。声明补充道：“尼日利亚属于我们所有人。没有任何总统野心值得以任何尼日利亚人的鲜血为代价。如果前总统古德勒克·乔纳森在2015年都能作出如此深刻的宣示，那么蒂努布总统在2026年就没有借口不作出同样的表态，并以行动证明其致力于和平的诚意。ADC不会因恐吓而退缩。我们将继续开展和平竞选，到2027年，尼日利亚人将有机会投票选择有能力、正直廉洁和全新开始的人。”立即获取内幕。实时报道、独家爆料和独家视角将直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于迟滞的新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时获取全天候最新消息→

https://leadership.ng/oriire-abduction-p.summary_zh: 他的回应紧随马金德披露的情况之后。马金德在采访中表示，在受害者被囚禁的50多天里，他始终没有与蒂努布总统说过话，尽管曾试图通过总统助理联系总统。奥格拉直接对州长表示，在蒂努布总统领导下，联邦政府仍专注于确保尼日利亚（国家，首都阿布贾）安全与繁荣这一使命。
https://leadership.ng/oriire-abduction-p.body: Senior Special Assistant to the President on Digital and New Media, Otega Ogra, said the Federal Government immediately deployed military and intelligence assets to Oyo State following the incident. Ogra, in a post on his X handle, said the operations led to the successful rescue of all the abducted children and teachers on July 10, 2026. His response followed Makinde’s disclosure during an interview that he did not speak with President Tinubu throughout the over 50 days the victims were held captive, despite attempts to reach the President through his aide. Addressing the governor directly, Ogra said the federal government remained focused on its mandate to secure and prosper Nigeria under President Tinubu. He maintained that the President prioritised concrete action and results over political point-scoring in addressing security challenges. According to him, the administration has introduced measures to strengthen the country’s security architecture, including the creation of a new Homeland Security position, improved coordination under the Office of the National Security Adviser (ONSA), and better equipment and remuneration for the military. He added that the government had also improved welfare across the security and intelligence agencies. On Makinde’s comments regarding the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC), Ogra stressed that the anti-graft agency remained independent and carried out its statutory responsibilities without political interference. He said President Tinubu had consistently maintained a non-interference policy regarding agencies and regulatory bodies with statutory independence. Ogra, however, criticised the governor’s comments, urging him to concentrate on governance and issue-based campaigning. “In my opinion, sir, political leaders like your good self should prioritise governance or focus on issues-based campaigning rather than such grandstanding that is now becoming the hallmark of your campaign,” he said. https://leadership.ng/oriire-abduction-p.body_zh: 总统数字与新媒体事务高级特别助理奥泰加·奥格拉表示，事件发生后，联邦政府立即向奥约州调配了军事和情报资源。奥格拉在其X账号发帖称，相关行动于2026年7月10日成功解救了所有被绑架的儿童和教师。此前，马金德在一次采访中透露，在受害者遭拘禁的50多天里，尽管他曾试图通过总统助手联系蒂努布总统，但一直没有与总统通话。奥格拉直接回应州长称，在蒂努布总统领导下，联邦政府始终专注于确保尼日利亚（国家，首都阿布贾）安全、实现繁荣这一使命。他坚持认为，在应对安全挑战时，总统更重视实际行动和成效，而非争取政治得分。据他介绍，当局已推出多项措施加强国家安全体系，包括新设国土安全职位、加强国家安全顾问办公室（ONSA）统筹协调，以及改善军队装备和薪酬。他还表示，政府也提升了安全和情报机构的整体福利。针对马金德有关经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）的评论，奥格拉强调，这个反腐机构仍保持独立，并在不受政治干预的情况下履行法定职责。他说，蒂努布总统始终奉行不干预依法独立运行之机构及监管部门的政策。不过，奥格拉批评了州长的言论，敦促他专注于治理和以具体问题为基础的竞选活动。他说：“依我之见，先生，像您这样优秀的政治领导人，应当优先关注治理或围绕具体问题开展竞选，而不是像现在这样大做姿态，而这正逐渐成为您竞选活动的标志。”我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、独家内幕消息和独家视角，直接推送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时随地接收全天候最新消息 →

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.summary: The recognition underscores Genesis Energy Holdings’commitment to advancing reliable electricity supply, developing critical power infrastructure and supporting the transformation of Lagos State’s energy sector through strategic investments and partnerships. Further demonstrating its commitment to expanding electricity infrastructure across Lagos State , GENESIS is developing Project Echo, the 260MW Ikorodu Power Project, in partnership with the Lagos State Government under the CLEM initiative.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.summary_zh: 此次认可凸显了Genesis Energy Holdings致力于推进可靠电力供应、建设关键电力基础设施，并通过战略投资与合作推动拉各斯州能源部门转型的承诺。GENESIS还在拉各斯州政府的CLEM倡议框架下与其合作开发“回声项目”，即装机容量为260MW的伊科罗杜电力项目，进一步体现其扩大拉各斯州电力基础设施的决心。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body: The awards presented to Genesis Energy Holding on the opening day of the Summit, at the Landmark Event Centre, Lagos, on Tuesday, 10 November2026, under the theme, “Lagos Energy Evolution: Transforming the Future.” includes the “Most Impactful Project (Power) Award” and the “Excellence in Energy – Summit Partner Appreciation Award.” The first was conferred on the company by Hon Sabur Akanbi Oluwa, Chairman of the Lagos State House of Assembly Committee on Energy and Mineral Resources, while the second award was conferred on the company by Hon. Biodun Ogunleye, Commissioner for Energy and Mineral Resources, Lagos State. The recognition underscores Genesis Energy Holdings’commitment to advancing reliable electricity supply, developing critical power infrastructure and supporting the transformation of Lagos State’s energy sector through strategic investments and partnerships. Through its subsidiary, GELMAK Power Solutions Ltd, the company operates the Banana Island Local Grid Project in Ikoyi, Lagos, an integrated power generation and distribution network providing reliable electricity to residential and commercial customers. Designed to reduce dependence on expensive and polluting diesel and heavy fuel oil (HFO) generators, the project currently records approximately 99% uptime. Its infrastructure capacity was recently doubled from 15MVA to 30MVA following the commissioning of an expanded substation, strengthening its ability to meet the growing electricity demand within the community. Further demonstrating its commitment to expanding electricity infrastructure across Lagos State , GENESIS is developing Project Echo, the 260MW Ikorodu Power Project, in partnership with the Lagos State Government under the CLEM initiative. With the Lagos State Market Operator as off-taker, the gas-fired power project is designed to deliver reliable, grid-integrated electricity, strengthening power supply across Ikorodu and supporting the development of a more resilient electricity market. Once operational, the project is expected to improve electricity availability for households, businesses and industries, while stimulating economic activity and supporting the area’s continued development. Commenting on the awards, Chairman and CEO of Genesis Energy, Mr Akinwole II Omoboriowo, said: “We want to extend our gratitude to Lagos State for giving us the opportunity to serve. We are most grateful for this recognition, which, for us, is both an honour and a call to action – a call to invest more. The business of energy is a very serious affair. Without energy, there can be no life. For us at GENESIS, it is not just a business; it is a lifelong commitment to uplifting our country and our continent, with Lagos State being at the forefront of that commitment.” These investments reflect the Group’s alignment with Lagos State’s electricity sector reform agenda, particularly the objectives of the Lagos State Electricity Law 2024, which provides a framework for developing a competitive, transparent and commercially viable electricity market. Since its establishment in 2005, Genesis Energy Holdings has developed and financed clean energy projects across Africa, with operations and project footprints spanning 11 African countries. The company deploys a diverse range of technologies, including solar photovoltaic (PV), battery energy storage systems (BESS), natural gas, wind, hydro and hybrid solutions, to develop reliable and sustainable energy infrastructure for businesses, governments and communities. Its Nigerian portfolio includes the 84MW gas-fired power project at the Port Harcourt Refinery Complex, one of Nigeria’s largest licensed private off-grid power plants and NIDI project in Kano. With a vision to “Light Up Africa One Community at a Time,” GENESIS remains committed to developing and deploying reliable, affordable and sustainable energy infrastructure that addresses the continent’s growing energy needs. Through strategic investments, innovative technologies and partnerships with governments and private-sector stakeholders, the company continues to advance energy access, strengthen energy security and support economic development across Africa

https://www.politico.eu/article/microsof.body: DUBLIN — Friday's widespread outage of Microsoft products has sparked a new wave of calls for Europe to control its own digital infrastructure — especially with the uncertain future of artificial intelligence at stake. "Only 20% of European digital services run on European infrastructure," Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch said in remarks Friday after he addressed EU national leaders during their first-ever meeting on artificial intelligence in Dublin. The money spent on foreign, U.S. or Chinese, technology "could be reinvested here, on infrastructure we control and [to] finance European research and development," said the boss of Europe's leading AI frontier lab. Mensch didn't specifically address the Microsoft outage, which lasted nearly 24 hours and affected millions of users in 74 countries. Still, the shutdown of key tools like Outlook email and Teams messaging impacted plenty of the tech and government leaders gathered in Dublin to chart Europe’s AI future. French President Emmanuel Macron closed the day with a post on X : “Our independence cannot be outsourced. It must be built here at home, in Europe,” he wrote. "When it comes to artificial intelligence, too, Europe has everything it takes to compete. We have no time to lose.” Tech sovereignty, including control over the cloud, chips and models that power AI, has been a rallying cry of the second mandate of European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, and was one of the key agenda items at Friday's gathering of the leaders of the EU's 27 member countries. "We have outsourced too much of our digital infrastructure to actors outside the EU," Finnish European Parliament lawmaker Aura Salla said in a press release Friday following the outage. She suggested that government contracts specifically "must support European technology." Others zoned in on the risk created by relying on digital infrastructure controlled by a couple of large companies. The Microsoft outage is a "reminder of the systemic risk created by concentrating digital infrastructure with a few global tech giants," said Sebastian Toffaletti, secretary general of the Digital SME Alliance, in a statement shared with POLITICO. In Germany, lawmaker Johannes Schätzl from the Social Democratic Party said it raised questions about public procurement. “Digital sovereignty must be measured by whether we can remain operational even during outages like this,” he said
https://www.politico.eu/article/microsof.title_zh: Microsoft 故障再次引发欧洲摆脱美国科技依赖的呼声
https://www.politico.eu/article/microsof.body_zh: 都柏林——微软旗下产品周五发生大范围故障，再次引发要求欧洲掌控自身数字基础设施的呼声，尤其是在人工智能前景存在不确定性的背景下。Mistral首席执行官Arthur Mensch周五发表讲话称：“欧洲只有20%的数字服务运行在欧洲的基础设施上。”他此前在都柏林举行的首次欧盟各国领导人人工智能会议上发表了演讲。这家欧洲领先的前沿人工智能实验室负责人说，花在外国、美国或中国技术上的资金“可以在这里重新投资，用于我们掌控的基础设施，并资助欧洲的研究与开发”。Mensch没有直接评论微软故障。这次故障持续近24小时，影响了74个国家的数百万用户。不过，包括Outlook电子邮件和Teams即时通信在内的关键工具中断，还是影响了许多齐聚都柏林、筹划欧洲人工智能未来的科技和政府领导人。法国总统Emmanuel Macron在X上发帖为当天收尾：“我们的独立不能外包。必须在这里、在欧洲亲手建设。”他写道：“谈到人工智能，欧洲同样具备参与竞争的一切条件。我们没有时间可以浪费。”包括掌控云、芯片和人工智能模型在内的技术主权，一直是欧洲委员会主席Ursula von der Leyen第二任期的号召，也是周五欧盟27个成员国领导人会议的主要议程之一。芬兰籍欧洲议会议员Aura Salla在故障发生后于周五发布的新闻稿中说：“我们已将太多数字基础设施外包给欧盟之外的参与者。”她建议，政府合同必须明确“支持欧洲技术”。其他人则将焦点放在依赖少数几家公司掌控的数字基础设施所带来的风险上。Digital SME Alliance秘书长Sebastian Toffaletti在与POLITICO分享的一份声明中说，微软故障“提醒人们，将数字基础设施集中在少数全球科技巨头手中，会造成系统性风险”。德国社会民主党的议员Johannes Schätzl表示，此事引出了有关公共采购的问题。他说：“数字主权必须以我们能否在此类故障期间仍保持运行为衡量标准。”

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.summary_zh: 尼日利亚驻南非高级专员费米·法尼-卡约德已向南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨递交国书，正式开始在南非的外交任职。星期五，法尼-卡约德先生在比勒陀利亚的塞法科·马加托总统官邸——南非总统府官方驻地——向拉马福萨先生递交了国书。法尼-卡约德先生与来自其他14个国家的大使一同递交了国书。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body: Nigeria’s High Commissioner to South Africa, Femi Fani-Kayode, has presented his Letter of Credence to South African President Cyril Ramaphosa, marking the official commencement of his diplomatic assignment in the country. Mr Fani-Kayode presented his letter to Mr Ramaphosa at the Sefako Makgatho Presidential Guest House in Pretoria, the official residence of the South African Presidency, on Friday. The High Commissioner shared the development on X, describing the event as “great and historic.” Letters of credence are formal diplomatic documents issued by a country’s head of state to confirm the appointment of a High Commissioner or permanent representative. They officially introduce the envoy to the receiving authority, in this case, the South African president, and certify that the individual is empowered to speak and act on behalf of their nation. Mr Fani-Kayode presented his letter of credence alongside ambassadors from 14 other countries. Each was formally introduced and given the floor to speak. He pledged to strengthen diplomatic relations between both countries, describing the restoration of their historic friendship as a key priority of his diplomatic mission. The envoy, also accredited to Lesotho and Eswatini, conveyed President Bola Tinubu’s goodwill to Mr Ramaphosa. This comes amid tense relations between Nigeria and South Africa over xenophobic violence that forced many African states to evacuate their citizens residing in the country. Mr Fani-Kayode had previously condemned violence against Nigerian nationals by South African security officials. He estimated that at least 30 Nigerians have been killed by the state’s police in the last four years. 12 Nigerians have also been killed since the start of the year. In September, the High Commissioner said Nigeria’s patience was running thin. Speaking at the ceremony, however, Mr Fani-Kayode recalled Nigeria’s support for South Africa during the struggle against apartheid, saying both countries shared a longstanding history of solidarity and friendship. He described Nigeria and South Africa as major trading partners on the continent and stressed the importance of preserving their historical ties. “Part of my job here is to reset that relationship, to come and build that bridge, and to ensure that whatever concerns we have, we can work them out and move forward together,” he said. Mr Fani-Kayode added that closer cooperation between the two countries would strengthen Africa’s position and advance the interests of their citizens. “If Nigeria and South Africa work closely together, the destiny of our great continent will be more secure,” he said. The high commissioner also commended South Africa’s contributions to international diplomacy, particularly its role in BRICS, the Global South and the Group of 20 (G20). He described South Africa’s engagement in global affairs as important to strengthening Africa’s representation on the international stage. Meanwhile, Mr Fani-Kayode, on his X handle, complained that the South African presidential media team failed to live-stream his speech despite capturing those of the other ambassadors present. “Of all the 15 introductions and speeches that were made and delivered this morning, only Nigeria’s was cut out,” he said. “To be clear, I repeat, we were the ONLY ones that were left out.” “Clearly, some elements in South Africa do not want to hear what we have to say or see our faces, but we are here to stay as long as we are welcome and have the confidence of President Ramaphosa, which I am sure we do,” he noted further
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.title_zh: 法尼-卡约德向拉马福萨递交国书，正式履任大使
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body_zh: 尼日利亚驻南非大使费米·法尼-卡约德向南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨递交国书，正式开始其在南非的外交任期。法尼-卡约德先生于星期五在比勒陀利亚的塞法科·马卡托总统迎宾馆——南非总统府官方官邸——向拉马福萨先生递交国书。大使在X平台分享了这一消息，称此次活动“重大而具有历史意义”。国书是由一国国家元首签发的正式外交文件，用于确认任命高级专员或常驻代表。国书向接受国主管机构正式介绍特使，本例中的接受国主管机构是南非总统，并证明该人士获授权代表本国发表言论和采取行动。法尼-卡约德先生与其他14个国家的大使一同递交国书。每位大使均获正式介绍，并获发言机会。他承诺加强两国外交关系，并将恢复两国历史友谊列为其外交使命的一项重点。该特使同时获派驻莱索托和斯威士兰，并向拉马福萨先生转达了博拉·蒂努布总统的友好问候。此前，尼日利亚与南非因针对外国人的暴力袭击而关系紧张，许多非洲国家被迫撤离居住在南非的本国公民。法尼-卡约德先生此前曾谴责南非安全官员针对尼日利亚公民的暴力行为。他估计，过去四年间，该国警察已造成至少30名尼日利亚人死亡。今年年初以来，又有12名尼日利亚人死亡。9月，大使表示尼日利亚的耐心已接近极限。不过，法尼-卡约德先生在仪式上回顾了尼日利亚在南非反抗种族隔离斗争期间对南非的支持，称两国共享源远流长的团结与友谊历史。他将尼日利亚和南非描述为非洲大陆的重要贸易伙伴，并强调维护两国历史联系的重要性。他说：“我在这里承担的工作之一，就是重置双方关系，前来搭建这座桥梁，并确保无论双方有何关切，都能共同解决分歧，携手向前。”法尼-卡约德先生补充说，两国加强合作将增强非洲的立场，并促进两国公民的利益。他说：“如果尼日利亚和南非紧密合作，我们这个伟大大陆的未来将更加稳固。”大使还赞扬南非对国际外交的贡献，尤其是南非在金砖国家、全球南方和二十国集团（G20）中的作用。他表示，南非参与全球事务对于加强非洲在国际舞台上的代表性至关重要。与此同时，法尼-卡约德先生在其X账号上抱怨，尽管南非总统媒体团队拍摄了其他在场大使的演讲，却未对本国演讲进行直播。他说：“今天上午进行的15次介绍和发言中，唯独尼日利亚的发言被剪掉了。”“明确地说，我再重复一遍，我们是唯一被排除在外的。”他进一步指出：“显然，南非某些人士不希望听到我们要说的话，也不希望看到我们的面孔；但只要我们受到欢迎，并得到拉马福萨总统的信任，我们就会留在这里。我确信我们确实得到了他的信任。”

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The US government is doubling down on its immigration control, with the State Department revoking over 6,000 visas belonging to foreigners engaged in or facilitating birth tourism. The department announced on Thursday, through its X handle, that its Birth Tourism Prevention Task Force had revoked the visas of people identified as involved in the practice. “The Department of State’s Birth Tourism Prevention Task Force has now revoked more than 6,000 visas from foreigners who engaged in or facilitated birth tourism,” the post read. It also said the task force is still identifying and “holding accountable everyone involved in this illicit practice.” This implies that more visas are likely to be revoked over this practice in the future. Birth tourism refers to travelling to another country, usually while pregnant, to give birth so the child can acquire that country’s citizenship or nationality by birth. The latest action signals a wider crackdown on both participants and facilitators, including those who help arrange such travel. Last month, the department announced that it had revoked over 4,000 visas, and that 700 of the revoked visas belonged to Chinese nationals. The latest statement, however, did not provide a breakdown by nationality. As such, it remains unclear whether Nigerians were among those affected. A core aspect of President Donald Trump’s “America first” policy and political campaigns has been a crackdown on immigration. The US leader, during his presidential campaigns, pledged to increase deportations of people living in the country, restrict asylum and refugee admissions, and tighten both illegal and some legal immigration pathways. Since resuming office, Mr Trump has implemented several policies aligned with this agenda. At the inauguration ceremony, for instance, he signed an executive order declaring illegal immigration a national emergency and ordered the speedy deportation of undocumented migrants. The United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement crackdown on migrants has, in the past year, been criticised for human rights violations. The Trump administration also imposed visa bans on several countries, including Nigeria. It is also planning to introduce a policy requiring foreign nationals in the US seeking to change their status from temporary visa holders to permanent residents to return to their home country to apply for a Green Card

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 美国政府正在加强移民管控。美国国务院吊销了6,000多张签证，持证人均为参与或协助“生育旅游”的外国人。该部门周四通过其X账号宣布，其“生育旅游防范特遣队”已吊销被认定参与这一行为者的签证。帖文称：“美国国务院生育旅游防范特遣队现已吊销6,000多张签证，涉及参与或协助生育旅游的外国人。”帖文还表示，特遣队仍在查明并“追究所有参与这一非法行为者的责任”。这意味着，未来可能还会因这一行为吊销更多签证。生育旅游是指前往另一个国家，通常在怀孕期间前往当地生产，使孩子通过出生取得该国国籍或身份。最新行动表明，美国正在更广泛地打击参与者和协助者，包括帮助安排此类旅行的人。上个月，该部门宣布已吊销4,000多张签证，其中700张被吊销的签证属于中国公民。不过，最新声明没有提供按国籍划分的明细。因此，目前尚不清楚尼日利亚公民是否在受影响的签证持有人之列。严厉打击移民一直是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普“美国优先”政策和政治竞选的核心内容之一。美国领导人在竞选期间承诺增加对居住在美国的外国人的驱逐力度，限制庇护和难民接收，并收紧非法移民以及部分合法移民通道。特朗普复任以来，已实施多项符合这一议程的政策。例如，在就职典礼上，他签署行政命令，将非法移民宣布为全国紧急状态，并下令迅速遣返无证移民。过去一年，美国移民与海关执法局针对移民的执法行动因侵犯人权而受到批评。特朗普政府还对包括尼日利亚在内的多个国家实施签证禁令。该政府还计划推出新政策，要求在美国希望从临时签证持有人身份转为永久居民的外籍人士返回其原籍国申请绿卡
